* [A homeowner and a dealer looking over a phone together next to a Generac home standby generator]

  We connect you with Authorized Generac Dealers in your area who can answer your questions and
  recommend the best home standby solution for your needs.
  
  [Learn about installation ][59]

  dealer to learn more.
  
  [Find a Dealer ][60]

  Find the right generator for your home
  
  We’re experts in every technical part and feature of our solutions so you don’t have to be. We’ll
  guide you to the right size generator for your needs. 
  
  [Try the Solution Finder ][61]

power they generate and bring the power they need on-the-go, wherever they go. So, we’ve built a
wide range of products to do just that.

  We’re proud to support campers, tailgaters and hard workers with portable generator solutions.

  With Generac solar power, solar battery storage, and smart home energy management, you can take
  control of your home’s energy—helping to reduce dependence on the grid and support your home
  during outages.
  
  [See Solar Battery Storage ][63]
* [A man using his Generac Power Washer outside on a sunny day.]
  
  Power through chores
  
  From pressure washers to water pumps, support your home and yard with the maintenance tools that
  power through even the toughest jobs.
  
  [Shop Home Maintenance ][64]

From the leader in emergency power and preparedness, Generac offers you a manageable way to guide

  [Shop Home Maintenance ][64]

  Petrochemicals Company
  We focus on eco-friendly materials to lead the sustainability business.
* **Advanced Materials [**Advanced Materials][156]
  Advanced Materials Company
  We aim to become a global top‑tier battery and electronic materials company leading
  next‑generation technologies.
* **Life Sciences [**Life Sciences][157]
  Life Sciences Company
  We aim to rise as a global pharmaceutical company that develops innovative new drugs.

Petrochemicals Company
We focus on eco-friendly materials to lead the sustainability business.
The Petrochemicals Company is LG Chem's major business area with world-class productivity and cost
competitiveness. We have established a vertically integrated system from basic raw materials such as
ethylene and propylene to downstream products such as PE, ABS, and synthetic rubber.
Advanced Materials Company
We aim to become a global top‑tier battery and electronic materials company leading next‑generation
technologies.
The Advanced Materials Company is enhancing our business competitiveness in specialty materials
through a market and customer-oriented approach.
Life Sciences Company
We aim to rise as a global pharmaceutical company that develops innovative new drugs.
As a new growth engine for the future to be fostered in the medium and long term, the Company has
differentiated R&D capabilities that have received new drug approval from the U.S. FDA for the first
time in Korea.

For more than a century, we’ve delivered stable, secure and scalable power solutions that revitalize
communities with new investments, new jobs and new purpose.

## Delivering for America

Grids don’t build or modernize themselves, and resilience doesn’t happen by chance. It happens when
you advance with purpose. NextEra Energy is always building — power plants of all kinds,
infrastructure to fuel them and the network to move the power they generate from coast to coast. 

 

### FPL: Shaping Florida's Energy Future

As America's largest electric utility, Florida Power & Light Company serves more than 6 million
accounts, providing electricity to around 12 million people in Florida. Known for its fuel- and
cost-efficient power generation, FPL focuses on keeping bills low while driving energy innovation
and reliability. FPL is leading the way in supporting Florida’s growth with continuous
infrastructure advancements.

[Visit FPL][28]

### NextEra Energy Resources: An Energy Pioneer

NextEra Energy Resources is advancing America’s energy future with the largest and most diverse
portfolio of power generation and infrastructure solutions. As one of the nation's top wholesale
generators of electric power, it leverages all forms of energy across renewables, storage, natural
gas and nuclear. NextEra Energy Resources offers a wide range of integrated solutions to help
utilities and businesses across the country meet their energy needs when and where they need it.

[Visit NextEra Energy Resources][29]

**America's leading transmission utility and leading competitive transmission developer**

[bar chart increase white outline icon]

**Better than top-decile operations across wind, solar, fossil and nuclear**

[ai artificial intelligence white outline icon]

**Industry leader in artificial intelligence and technology**

Across our company, more than 17,000 employees are actively giving back to the community. Whether
it's volunteering at local events or supporting animals in need, our people lead with heart. It’s
all part of our commitment to making a positive impact where we live and work.

Discover your next opportunity at the forefront of the energy industry. Be part of a team that
powers American homes, businesses and dreams, now and in the future.

# 
# Powering Today. Building Tomorrow.™

[Green horizontal line.]

 

## 100+ Years of Powering Progress

For more than a century, we’ve delivered stable, secure and scalable power solutions that revitalize
communities with new investments, new jobs and new purpose.

[Powering today. Building tomorrow]
[x][27]

## NextEra Energy is
## Delivering for America

Grids don’t build or modernize themselves, and resilience doesn’t happen by chance. It happens when
you advance with purpose. NextEra Energy is always building — power plants of all kinds,
infrastructure to fuel them and the network to move the power they generate from coast to coast. 

 

### FPL: Shaping Florida's Energy Future

As America's largest electric utility, Florida Power & Light Company serves more than 6 million
accounts, providing electricity to around 12 million people in Florida. Known for its fuel- and
cost-efficient power generation, FPL focuses on keeping bills low while driving energy innovation
and reliability. FPL is leading the way in supporting Florida’s growth with continuous
infrastructure advancements.

[Visit FPL][28]

### NextEra Energy Resources: An Energy Pioneer

NextEra Energy Resources is advancing America’s energy future with the largest and most diverse
portfolio of power generation and infrastructure solutions. As one of the nation's top wholesale
generators of electric power, it leverages all forms of energy across renewables, storage, natural
gas and nuclear. NextEra Energy Resources offers a wide range of integrated solutions to help
utilities and businesses across the country meet their energy needs when and where they need it.

[Visit NextEra Energy Resources][29]

### **We build and operate all forms of energy **

[diverse energy mix white outline icon]

**America's leading energy infrastructure builder**

[florida map white outline icon]

**Owner and operator of the largest electric utility in the U.S.**

[solar panels white outline icon]

**World leader in renewables¹**

[battery white outline icon]

**World leader in battery storage**

[nuclear symbol white outline]

**Operates one of America's largest nuclear fleets**

[electrical distribution lines white outline icon]

**America's leading transmission utility and leading competitive transmission developer**

[bar chart increase white outline icon]

**Better than top-decile operations across wind, solar, fossil and nuclear**

[ai artificial intelligence white outline icon]

**Industry leader in artificial intelligence and technology**

[Learn more][30]

### In Our Community

Across our company, more than 17,000 employees are actively giving back to the community. Whether
it's volunteering at local events or supporting animals in need, our people lead with heart. It’s
all part of our commitment to making a positive impact where we live and work.

### Join the Next Era

Discover your next opportunity at the forefront of the energy industry. Be part of a team that
powers American homes, businesses and dreams, now and in the future.

[Explore Careers][31]

### The Latest in Energy: News & Insights 

Stay updated with the latest on company milestones, and how NextEra Energy is shaping the future of
power. 

[FPL and Dominion Energy bucket trucks]

gigawatts of natural gas‑powered generation in Texas and Pennsylvania.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]

points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]

boosting income for the local community by 60%.

## FAQs

### ### How long do solar panels really last?

Solar panels can last anywhere between 25 to 30 years, sometimes more. This doesn’t mean that the
panels on your roof will stop producing electricity after a couple of decades. It just means their
energy production will decrease by what solar panel manufacturers consider optimal to meet the
average household's energy needs. With proper care and maintenance, you can expect to receive
significant solar benefits for the next 20 to 30 years.

### ### What happens if I decide to move?

Sunrun makes it easy to transfer your solar lease agreement to the new homeowners. Our service
transfer specialists handle everything from educating realtors and potential buyers to working with
escrow officers, title agents, home inspectors, and anyone else who might need to know about your
system or solar lease agreement. When you decide to move, get started in our[ Service Transfer
Portal][47] for everything you need for a successful transfer. [Learn more][48].

### ### How much can I expect to save when I go solar?

When you sign up for a free quote, our in-house Solar Advisors will work with you to determine how
much you can expect to save on your monthly energy bill. This relies on factors like your utility,
how much electricity you use and how much sunlight your home gets. We’ll only recommend solar if
it’s the right fit for your home energy needs and profile.

### ### Does my state offer incentives to go solar?

See where Sunrun currently operates and what solar incentives may be available in your state. The
most common solar incentives include state tax credits, net metering and rebates from your local
utility. No matter what state you live in, you’ll also be eligible for the federal solar tax credit
when you purchase your own solar system.

The great thing about BrightSave Monthly is that any benefits you would get through rebates and tax
credits come to you in the form of a lower monthly cost with Sunrun. You can avoid high upfront
costs, and we'll take care of the paperwork.

## FAQs

### ### How long do solar panels really last?

Solar panels can last anywhere between 25 to 30 years, sometimes more. This doesn’t mean that the
panels on your roof will stop producing electricity after a couple of decades. It just means their
energy production will decrease by what solar panel manufacturers consider optimal to meet the
average household's energy needs. With proper care and maintenance, you can expect to receive
significant solar benefits for the next 20 to 30 years.

### ### What happens if I decide to move?

Sunrun makes it easy to transfer your solar lease agreement to the new homeowners. Our service
transfer specialists handle everything from educating realtors and potential buyers to working with
escrow officers, title agents, home inspectors, and anyone else who might need to know about your
system or solar lease agreement. When you decide to move, get started in our[ Service Transfer
Portal][47] for everything you need for a successful transfer. [Learn more][48].

### ### How much can I expect to save when I go solar?

When you sign up for a free quote, our in-house Solar Advisors will work with you to determine how
much you can expect to save on your monthly energy bill. This relies on factors like your utility,
how much electricity you use and how much sunlight your home gets. We’ll only recommend solar if
it’s the right fit for your home energy needs and profile.

### ### Does my state offer incentives to go solar?

See where Sunrun currently operates and what solar incentives may be available in your state. The
most common solar incentives include state tax credits, net metering and rebates from your local
utility. No matter what state you live in, you’ll also be eligible for the federal solar tax credit
when you purchase your own solar system.

The great thing about BrightSave Monthly is that any benefits you would get through rebates and tax
credits come to you in the form of a lower monthly cost with Sunrun. You can avoid high upfront
costs, and we'll take care of the paperwork.

AES está profundamente arraigada en la cultura y las costumbres locales. Invertimos en nuestras

storage systems by using a FAKE AlphaESS logo and real AlphaESS products photos.

the intellectual property rights of AlphaESS.

more people get deceived.

## Why Installers Choose Alternergy

## 

## Who We Are

Since 2006, Alternergy has built a reputation as one of the UK’s most trusted solar trade suppliers,
known for expertise, value, reliable service, and forward-thinking solutions. We support the UK’s
clean energy transition by delivering future-ready technologies to installers, developers, and trade
professionals nationwide.

We’ve streamlined the customer journey through efficient online systems. From home installations to
large commercial sites, we supply and support solar and battery storage projects across the UK and
Ireland, backed by Tier 1 partners and dedicated trade support.

## What We Offer

We supply a wide range of advanced solar products from globally recognised manufacturers, including
solar panels from DAS Solar, Tongwei, TCL SunPower, Viridian, and Trina Solar, as well as solar
inverters from GoodWe, Haier, and Sungrow.

Our product portfolio also features high-performance solar battery storage systems from Dunext,
GoodWe, Haier, Sungrow, and Sunwoda, with models suited to residential, commercial, and industrial
(C&I) installations, depending on brand and specification.

We stock roof-integrated solar solutions from Viridian Solar and S4 In-Roof Mounting, as well as K2
Mounting Systems, EV chargers, and a full range of PV accessories, all designed to enable efficient
installations that comply with MCS standards.

## Clean Energy Made Affordable ✕

We believe solar energy is essential to tackling climate change. Every PV system we supply supports
a low-carbon future.

By offering affordable, high-quality solar energy products and battery storage solutions, we help
trade professionals cut emissions and reduce energy costs.

## Installer Hub - Tools & Resources ✕

Our PV installation support resources include MCS-compliant documentation, product datasheets,
certifications, brochures, and warranty information.

Installers also benefit from our in-house [ACE PV design tool][156] and ongoing updates via our
technical blog, newsletter, and social channels.

## Trade Support - More Than a Distributor ✕

With a trade-only platform, real-time stock visibility, and fast UK-wide delivery, we help
installers work efficiently.

For commercial projects, we provide tailored support in collaboration with partners.

Our core values – Quality, Value, Integrity – guide everything we do.

## Why Installers Choose Alternergy

## 

## Who We Are

Since 2006, Alternergy has built a reputation as one of the UK’s most trusted solar trade suppliers,
known for expertise, value, reliable service, and forward-thinking solutions. We support the UK’s
clean energy transition by delivering future-ready technologies to installers, developers, and trade
professionals nationwide.

We’ve streamlined the customer journey through efficient online systems. From home installations to
large commercial sites, we supply and support solar and battery storage projects across the UK and
Ireland, backed by Tier 1 partners and dedicated trade support.

## What We Offer

We supply a wide range of advanced solar products from globally recognised manufacturers, including
solar panels from DAS Solar, Tongwei, TCL SunPower, Viridian, and Trina Solar, as well as solar
inverters from GoodWe, Haier, and Sungrow.

Our product portfolio also features high-performance solar battery storage systems from Dunext,
GoodWe, Haier, Sungrow, and Sunwoda, with models suited to residential, commercial, and industrial
(C&I) installations, depending on brand and specification.

We stock roof-integrated solar solutions from Viridian Solar and S4 In-Roof Mounting, as well as K2
Mounting Systems, EV chargers, and a full range of PV accessories, all designed to enable efficient
installations that comply with MCS standards.

We believe solar energy is essential to tackling climate change. Every PV system we supply supports
a low-carbon future.

By offering affordable, high-quality solar energy products and battery storage solutions, we help
trade professionals cut emissions and reduce energy costs.

## Installer Hub - Tools & Resources ✕

Our PV installation support resources include MCS-compliant documentation, product datasheets,
certifications, brochures, and warranty information.

Installers also benefit from our in-house [ACE PV design tool][156] and ongoing updates via our
technical blog, newsletter, and social channels.

## Trade Support - More Than a Distributor ✕

With a trade-only platform, real-time stock visibility, and fast UK-wide delivery, we help
installers work efficiently.

For commercial projects, we provide tailored support in collaboration with partners.

Industrial energy infrastructure

# Procuring storage
# should not be an
# engineering project.

We curate the single highest-performing BESS architecture globally. No marketplaces. No broker fees.
Just deployment certainty.

Begin technical intake
6
Months.
Logistics guarantee

### Delivered Duty Paid.
### To your foundation.

From manufacturing allocation to final site placement, we manage all shipping, multi-jurisdictional
customs, and tax liabilities. You pour the pad; we drop the system.

IncotermsStrictly DDP
Lead time≤ 6 months
[Industrial 20-foot BESS container — neutral studio rendering]
Asset lifecycle

### Comprehensive coverage.
### Zero capex surprises.

A storage system is only as viable as its degradation curve. Ten years of hardware and performance
coverage are baked into the unit price. Performance guarantee: 69.7% SoH at 8,000 cycles or 10
years.

Duration120 months
CoverageDefect + degradation
10
Years.

## We don't broker.
## We commit.

#### The problem with choice

Marketplace listings normalise dozens of OEMs onto comparable spec sheets, hiding sub-component
variance behind unified columns. Buyers end up evaluating incompatible systems, taking on
integration and delivery risk that doesn't show up until the project is already running.

#### Our mechanism

Our engineering team continuously evaluates the global supply chain against real deployment data.

We commit to the single highest-performing LFP system available worldwide and lock in delivery and
warranty terms on your behalf. You don't get a list of speculative options. You get the definitive
answer to industrial-scale storage.

Current default specification

Verified

≤ 2 × 1.25 MW

1164.8 – 1497.8 V

≥ 8,000 cycles@ 0.5C / 0.5C

90.0%

< 1 s

−30 to +60 °Cde-rated > 40 °C
Maximum altitude
< 2,000 m

DC liquid cooling
Anticorrosion
C4H standard · C5 optional

Suppression

Detection
Photoelectric · thermal · smoke
Fire control

#### Certifications

UL 1973 · UL 9540 · UL 9540A · IEC 62619 · IEC 62620 · UN 38.3 · NFPA 855
PCS
UL 1741 · IEC 62109-1/2 · G99 · NEC 2020 · IEC 62116 · VDE 4110 · EN 50549-2 · IEC 60529 · IEC
61000-6-2

Modbus · RS485 · IEC 104
Transport
Ethernet · LTE · fiber

## the gap between first-life and second-life Battery Energy Storage Systems (SL-BESS), increase

# WHAT IS BIG LEAP?

The BIG LEAP project is a Horizon Europe initiative aimed at improving the reliability of
second-life batteries (SLBs) by addressing interoperability in Battery Management Systems (BMS). It
develops a three-layer BMS architecture specifically designed for SLBs and integrates an adaptable
Energy Storage System (ESS) to ensure safe performance from first-life (FL) to second-life BESS
applications. 

# The BIG LEAP project is dedicated to overcoming barriers in the reuse of old batteries in energy
# storage

## OBJECTIVES

The overall objective of BIG LEAP is to enhance Second-Life Battery Energy Storage Systems (SL-BESS)
applications by designing efficient 3-layered Battery Management Systems (BMS) and Energy Storage
Systems (ESS), ensuring economic viability, flexibility, and industry-wide standardization.

**1**


BMS and ESS development
with three layers that make it easy to reconfigure batteries for different applications.

**2**


In-site End-of-Life (EoL) diagnosis and safety recalibration. We aim to extend the operational
lifetime of batteries while reducing refurbishing costs. 

**3**


Offering three degrees of openness for swift industrial deployment through our innovative Battery
Management System is interoperable, adaptable, and updatable.

## **ENERGETIC **

An innovative artificial intelligence-based approach to improve battery energy storage Facilitating
grid flexibility through energy storage is crucial for accommodating higher levels of renewable
penetration, ushering in a more electrified and decarbonised society through the repurposing of
second-life batteries.

[ Link ][46]

## **NEXTBAT **

Aims to significantly contribute to decrease the carbon footprint of the innovative battery system
by decreasing production costs thanks to the high recyclability capacity of hardware and cells
components along the production chain.

[ Link ][47]

## **BATTERY2LIFE **

BATTERY2LIFE is a project, funded by Horizon Europe programme that will facilitate the smooth
transition of batteries to 2nd life use and boost the innovation of the European Battery Industry by
providing enablers to implement open, adaptable smart Battery Management Systems (BMSes) and
improved system designs towards reliable reconfiguration of used batteries. Two demonstrations that
represent two promising and sustainable business cases, serving the two most common stationary
applications have been carefully selected: The domestic and industrial (grid-scale) storage, with
respect to their operational specificities and requirements. The project’s duration extends from
January 2024 to December 2026

[ Link ][48]

## **BATTERY 2030+ **

BATTERY 2030+ is the large-scale and long-term European research initiative with the vision of
inventing the sustainable batteries of the future, providing European industry with disruptive
technologies and a competitive edge throughout the battery value chain and enabling Europe to reach
the goals of a climate-neutral society envisaged in the European Green Deal. The BATTERY 2030+
community works on concrete actions that support the implementation of the European Green Deal, the
UN Sustainable Development Goals, the European Action Plan on Batteries and the SET Plan.
[ Link ][49]

## **BATT4EU **

BATT4EU is a Co-programmed Partnership established under Horizon Europe, the Framework Programme for
Research and Innovation of the European Union. BATT4EU is a collaboration of the European Commission
and European battery R&I stakeholders, united in BEPA.

[ Link ][50]

## **RECIRCULATE **

RECIRCULATE is an EU funded project that aims to revolutionize the European battery sector by
developing the technologies and systems required to enable cascading reuse of batteries and battery
components at their end-of-life. RECIRCULATE envisions a future where batteries have an extended
lifespan in second and third-life applications, and are only recycled when their maximum value has
been extracted, leading to a more sustainable and resource-efficient battery sector.

[ Link ][51]

## **REINFORCE **

In the search for sustainable mobility and energy system transition solutions, batteries emerge as a
fundamental technology for the advancement of electric cars, renewable energy storage, and the
reduction of carbon emissions. 

REINFORCE aims at creating a circular value chain for batteries, which promises to transform the
life cycle of these products. Used, defective and unstable batteries pose new challenges along the
supply chain and require new industrial processes, automated equipment, and tracking systems, as
well as new strategies to prepare them for a second or third life, or even for the recycling of
their components and materials.

[ Link ][52]

## **BATMAX **

The main objective of the project is to contribute to improving battery system performance, safety,
reliability, service life, lifetime cost and therefore to maximise the value created by operation of
the battery systems in various kinds of end use applications. To concretise the pathways towards
reaching the main objective, BATMAX partners are exploring emerging opportunities for optimised
battery utilisation across the technical scope. The main objective is approached by creating a
framework for next generation of battery management based on large amounts of data, both
experimental, operational and synthetic, adaptable physics-based models, suitable reduced-order
models for both physical BMS algorithms and real-time multi-scale digital twins.

[ Link ][53]

## **BatteReverse **

BatteReverse is working towards building the next generation of battery reverse logistics. 1.7
million tonnes of batteries will have reached their end of life by 2030. We are developing necessary
technologies, processes, and partnerships to give EV batteries a second life. Through a set of
activities, we are enhancing efficiency and safety, demonstrate innovative reverse logistics pilots,
and empower the European circularity.
[ Link ][54]

## **Rebelion **

REBELION is a project funded by the European Union with the objective of addressing the waste
management challenges posed by lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) used in electric mobility. After their
second life, recycling represents not only the most environmentally friendly alternative for
batteries, but also a natural and economic resource since the raw materials contained in LIBs can be
valorised for further manufacturing. This is particularly relevant in the EU, which is a net
importer of critical raw materials while up to 40% of the EVs are sold in Europe. Therefore, a solid
recycling industry can become the European mining equivalent, promoting both environmental and
economic benefits to the EU region.

[ Link ][55]

## **Haven Project **

HAVEN is innovating energy storage systems by developing a Hybrid Energy Storage Solution (HESS)
that can store energy for long periods and provide multiple grid support services. This advanced
solution utilizes next-generation storage technologies, optimized power converters, and advanced
energy management tools, ensuring modularity, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.

[ Link ][56]

## **TradeRES **

The TradeRES project will develop and test innovative electricity market designs that can meet
society’s needs of a (near) 100% renewable power system. A long-term sustainable market design needs
to provide efficient operational and investment incentives for an electricity system that is
characterized by a high share of variable renewable energy sources (VREs) by increasing integration
with other energy sectors, e.g. transport and hydrogen, and by increasing participation of flexible
electricity demand from households to industrial consumers. Furthermore, this market design needs to
provide security of supply by ensuring sufficient controllable electricity generation capacity
whilst being economically efficient. Finally, despite the variability of solar and wind energy, the
market risks should be allocated in an efficient and socially accepted way. This should also

In-site End-of-Life (EoL) diagnosis and safety recalibration. We aim to extend the operational
lifetime of batteries while reducing refurbishing costs. 

**3**


Offering three degrees of openness for swift industrial deployment through our innovative Battery
Management System is interoperable, adaptable, and updatable.

## **ENERGETIC **

An innovative artificial intelligence-based approach to improve battery energy storage Facilitating
grid flexibility through energy storage is crucial for accommodating higher levels of renewable
penetration, ushering in a more electrified and decarbonised society through the repurposing of
second-life batteries.

[ Link ][46]

## **NEXTBAT **

Aims to significantly contribute to decrease the carbon footprint of the innovative battery system
by decreasing production costs thanks to the high recyclability capacity of hardware and cells
components along the production chain.

[ Link ][47]

## **BATTERY2LIFE **

BATTERY2LIFE is a project, funded by Horizon Europe programme that will facilitate the smooth
transition of batteries to 2nd life use and boost the innovation of the European Battery Industry by
providing enablers to implement open, adaptable smart Battery Management Systems (BMSes) and
improved system designs towards reliable reconfiguration of used batteries. Two demonstrations that
represent two promising and sustainable business cases, serving the two most common stationary
applications have been carefully selected: The domestic and industrial (grid-scale) storage, with
respect to their operational specificities and requirements. The project’s duration extends from
January 2024 to December 2026

[ Link ][48]

## **BATTERY 2030+ **

BATTERY 2030+ is the large-scale and long-term European research initiative with the vision of
inventing the sustainable batteries of the future, providing European industry with disruptive
technologies and a competitive edge throughout the battery value chain and enabling Europe to reach
the goals of a climate-neutral society envisaged in the European Green Deal. The BATTERY 2030+
community works on concrete actions that support the implementation of the European Green Deal, the
UN Sustainable Development Goals, the European Action Plan on Batteries and the SET Plan.
[ Link ][49]

## **BATT4EU **

BATT4EU is a Co-programmed Partnership established under Horizon Europe, the Framework Programme for
Research and Innovation of the European Union. BATT4EU is a collaboration of the European Commission
and European battery R&I stakeholders, united in BEPA.

[ Link ][50]

## **RECIRCULATE **

RECIRCULATE is an EU funded project that aims to revolutionize the European battery sector by
developing the technologies and systems required to enable cascading reuse of batteries and battery
components at their end-of-life. RECIRCULATE envisions a future where batteries have an extended
lifespan in second and third-life applications, and are only recycled when their maximum value has
been extracted, leading to a more sustainable and resource-efficient battery sector.

[ Link ][51]

## **REINFORCE **

In the search for sustainable mobility and energy system transition solutions, batteries emerge as a
fundamental technology for the advancement of electric cars, renewable energy storage, and the
reduction of carbon emissions. 

REINFORCE aims at creating a circular value chain for batteries, which promises to transform the
life cycle of these products. Used, defective and unstable batteries pose new challenges along the
supply chain and require new industrial processes, automated equipment, and tracking systems, as
well as new strategies to prepare them for a second or third life, or even for the recycling of
their components and materials.

[ Link ][52]

## **BATMAX **

The main objective of the project is to contribute to improving battery system performance, safety,
reliability, service life, lifetime cost and therefore to maximise the value created by operation of
the battery systems in various kinds of end use applications. To concretise the pathways towards
reaching the main objective, BATMAX partners are exploring emerging opportunities for optimised
battery utilisation across the technical scope. The main objective is approached by creating a
framework for next generation of battery management based on large amounts of data, both
experimental, operational and synthetic, adaptable physics-based models, suitable reduced-order
models for both physical BMS algorithms and real-time multi-scale digital twins.

[ Link ][53]

## **BatteReverse **

BatteReverse is working towards building the next generation of battery reverse logistics. 1.7
million tonnes of batteries will have reached their end of life by 2030. We are developing necessary
technologies, processes, and partnerships to give EV batteries a second life. Through a set of
activities, we are enhancing efficiency and safety, demonstrate innovative reverse logistics pilots,
and empower the European circularity.
[ Link ][54]

## **Rebelion **

REBELION is a project funded by the European Union with the objective of addressing the waste
management challenges posed by lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) used in electric mobility. After their
second life, recycling represents not only the most environmentally friendly alternative for
batteries, but also a natural and economic resource since the raw materials contained in LIBs can be
valorised for further manufacturing. This is particularly relevant in the EU, which is a net
importer of critical raw materials while up to 40% of the EVs are sold in Europe. Therefore, a solid
recycling industry can become the European mining equivalent, promoting both environmental and
economic benefits to the EU region.

[ Link ][55]

## **Haven Project **

HAVEN is innovating energy storage systems by developing a Hybrid Energy Storage Solution (HESS)
that can store energy for long periods and provide multiple grid support services. This advanced
solution utilizes next-generation storage technologies, optimized power converters, and advanced
energy management tools, ensuring modularity, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.

[ Link ][56]

## **TradeRES **

The TradeRES project will develop and test innovative electricity market designs that can meet
society’s needs of a (near) 100% renewable power system. A long-term sustainable market design needs
to provide efficient operational and investment incentives for an electricity system that is
characterized by a high share of variable renewable energy sources (VREs) by increasing integration
with other energy sectors, e.g. transport and hydrogen, and by increasing participation of flexible
electricity demand from households to industrial consumers. Furthermore, this market design needs to

[ AA Ni-MH Batteries ][220]
The Japanese Sanyo electrode technology and explosion-proof patents ensure safety longevity.
[ AAA Ni-MH Batteries ][221]
Long-term power retention and no memory effect. Perfect for tiny gadgets (such as glucose meters and
earbuds).
[ AAAA Ni-MH Batteries ][222]
The dimensions of the AAAA nickel-metal hydride (NiMH) battery are 7.5–8.2 mm in diameter, 41.5–42.5
mm in length, and 300 mAh in capacity. It provides long-lasting energy for small electrical gadgets
and is both powerful and compact.
[ AAAAA Ni-MH Batteries ][223]
The dimensions of the AAAAA nickel-metal hydride (NiMH) battery are 6.3-7.0 mm in diameter,
40.0-41.5 mm in length, and 200mAh in capacity.
[ 9V Ni-MH Batteries ][224]
The 9V nickel-metal hydride (NiMH) battery has a thickness of 17.5 mm, a width of 26.5 mm, a height
of 48.5 mm, and a capacity of 150–250 mAh. It is commonly used in instrumentation and has reasonably
uniform specifications for NiMH battery models.
[ C-Type Ni-MH Batteries ][225]
Has a diameter of 25.0-25.5 mm, a height of 48.5-50.0 mm, and a capacity between 2,600 and 5,500
mAh. Applications for it include mining equipment, lighting systems, electric windows, and more.
[ C-Type Ni-MH Explosionproof Battery ][226]
In today's industrial field, safety is always the top priority. Especially in flammable and
explosive environments, the safety of equipment cannot be ignored.
[ D-Type Ni-MH Batteries ][227]
Batteries of the BPl D type offer many benefits. They can supply long-lasting power for high-power
devices (such searchlights, power tools, and outdoor speakers) with a capacity of up to 17,000 mAh.
[ D-Type NiMH Explosionproof Battery ][228]
D-Type NiMH Explosion-Proof Battery offer many benefits. They can supply long-lasting power for
high-power devices (such searchlights, power tools, and outdoor speakers) with a capacity of up to
17,000 mAh.
[ F-Type Ni-MH Batteries ][229]
Type F nickel-metal hydride (NiMH) cells have a diameter of 32.0-32.5 mm, a height of 88.5-91 mm,
and a capacity of 10,000-16,000 mAh. Among NiMH cell models, they exhibit relatively stable
performance.
[ F-Type NiMH Explosionproof Battery ][230]
F-Type NiMH Explosion-Proof Battery has a diameter of 32.0-32.5 mm, a height of 88.5-91 mm, and a
capacity of 10,000-16,000 mAh. Among NiMH cell models, it exhibits relatively stable performance.
[ M-Type Ni-MH Batteries ][231]
M-type nickel-metal hydride (NiMH) batteries have a diameter of 39.5-42.0 mm, a height of 89.0-91.5
mm, and a capacity of 20,000-25,000 mAh.
[ M-Type NiMH Explosionproof Battery ][232]
BPI is acompany that has been deeply involved in the battery industry for many years. lts
M-typenickel-hydrogen batteries have attracted much attention in the market.
[ SC-Type Ni-MH Batteries ][233]
There are two types of SC-type nickel-metal hydride (NiMH) batteries: ordinary SC-type and
high-power SC-type. lt measures 41.5-43.0 mm in height, 21.5-22.5 mm in diameter and 1,300-3,000 mAh
in capacity.
[ High-Temp Ni-MH Batteries ][234]
Designed for extreme environments, operates stably at 90'C with over 60% discharge efficiency.
Equipped with explosion-proof patented technology, compatible with automotive electronics
(T-BOX/0BD) and high-temperature lighting systems.
[ Wide-Temp Ni-MH Batteries ][235]
It can operate in a temperature range of -40℃ to +85℃ and has high-rate charge and discharge
capability. It has a cycle life of over 500 cycles at high temperatures and an efficiency of over
50% in extreme environments.
[ Low-Temp Ni-MH Batteries ][236]
Engineered for extreme cold (-40℃) with 46% discharge efficiency. Low internal resistance (16.6mΩ)
and high discharge platform.
[ Ultra-Low Self-Discharge Ni-MH Batteries ][237]
Engineered for extreme cold (-40℃) with 46% discharge efficiency. Low internal resistance (16.6mΩ)

# CTECHI Battery

With 21 years of expertise in energy storage, CTECHI offers comprehensive one-stop battery products
and solutions to power the global green energy future.

[More Products][206][Contact Us][207]
[ [Energy Storage Systems] ][208]

### [Energy Storage Systems][209]

CTECHi ESS solutions, encompassing residential and industrial systems, deliver reliable, certified
energy storage with advanced features, supporting diverse applications from homes to large-scale
commercial and industrial settings.

[ [Motive Power Batteries] ][210]

### [Motive Power Batteries][211]

CTECHi offers eco-friendly, long-lasting LFP batteries for low-speed vehicles, providing safe,
lightweight, and maintenance-free solutions that enhance efficiency and value across industries.

## CTECHI Battery Provides One-Stop Battery Solutions

Shenzhen CTECHi Technology Co., Ltd., a global energy storage expert with 21 years of battery
industry experience, specializes in customized, high-performance, cost-effective battery solutions
and full-service support, including R&D, ODM, OEM, and SKD services, to meet diverse market needs.

With 21 years of expertise in energy storage, CTECHI offers comprehensive one-stop battery products
and solutions to power the global green energy future.

[More Products][206][Contact Us][207]

### [Energy Storage Systems][209]

CTECHi ESS solutions, encompassing residential and industrial systems, deliver reliable, certified
energy storage with advanced features, supporting diverse applications from homes to large-scale
commercial and industrial settings.

### [Motive Power Batteries][211]

CTECHi offers eco-friendly, long-lasting LFP batteries for low-speed vehicles, providing safe,
lightweight, and maintenance-free solutions that enhance efficiency and value across industries.

Shenzhen CTECHi Technology Co., Ltd., a global energy storage expert with 21 years of battery
industry experience, specializes in customized, high-performance, cost-effective battery solutions
and full-service support, including R&D, ODM, OEM, and SKD services, to meet diverse market needs.

## Delivering Power Solutions for the Next Generation

Power your energy transition with reliable, sustainable solutions. We help businesses reduce energy
costs, enhance energy resilience, and achieve asset flexibility through **on-site power generation
and battery energy storage** - delivering EPC solutions tailored for a cleaner, more resilient
future.

[ How We Support You ][227]
[ Previous ][228]
[ Next ][229]

## Our Energy Solutions

[products-mwm-gas-engines_500x325]

##### MWM Gas Engines

Improve energy cost savings, resilience, and sustainability with high-efficiency gas engines rated
400kWe - 4,500kWe.

[Learn more][230]
[Edina-FTM-Battery-Storage-Installation]

##### Battery Energy Storage

Store and discharge energy on-site and reduce your grid dependency with a Tier-1 BESS solution.

[Learn more][231]
[Diesel Generator within an acoustic enclosure]

##### Emergency Backup Generation

Ensuring power continuity 24/7 allowing your business to focus on its core activities.

[Learn more][232]
[containerised-genset-installation_1920x1440]

##### Engineering, Procurement, and Construction

From project design and installation to asset care, we deliver the total solution to reduce
ambiguity.

[Learn more][233]
[Containerised Diesel Generator]

##### Manufacturing

Accelerate your project programme with our range of control panels, switchgear, and acoustic
enclosures.

[Learn more][234]
[Edina Service Engineer]

##### Service

We provide expert asset care of your gas engines, standby generators, and battery storage to
maximise plant performance and guarantee 24/7 availability.

[Learn more][235]

## Backed by Super Energy Efficiency Public ESCO

Edina and EPSL (Edina Power Service Limited) Trigeneration Pvt Ltd are owned by Super Energy Service
Company (ESCO), Energy Efficiency Services Limited (EESL), under the Ministry of Power, Government
of India.

[ Discover MWM Gas Engines ][236]

## Why Edina?

shuffle

#### Agile scope of work

Whether you're procuring a single supply, a multi-plant configuration, or a hybrid system
integrating generation, battery storage, and balance of plant, our four decades of grid interfacing
and engineering expertise ensure your project's success.

strategy

#### Meet your strategic requirement

Our installations demonstrate some of the highest operational and availability figures in the
industry, ensuring the optimal performance of your on-site generation and battery storage asset to
maximise your return on investment.

handshake

#### Mitigate risk and expedite project delivery

Edina can deliver your engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contract and manufacturing
requirements from a single point of delivery.

## Delivering Power Solutions for the Next Generation

Power your energy transition with reliable, sustainable solutions. We help businesses reduce energy
costs, enhance energy resilience, and achieve asset flexibility through **on-site power generation
and battery energy storage** - delivering EPC solutions tailored for a cleaner, more resilient
future.

[ How We Support You ][227]

## Our Energy Solutions

[products-mwm-gas-engines_500x325]

##### MWM Gas Engines

Improve energy cost savings, resilience, and sustainability with high-efficiency gas engines rated
400kWe - 4,500kWe.

[Learn more][230]
[Edina-FTM-Battery-Storage-Installation]

##### Battery Energy Storage

Store and discharge energy on-site and reduce your grid dependency with a Tier-1 BESS solution.

[Learn more][231]
[Diesel Generator within an acoustic enclosure]

##### Emergency Backup Generation

Ensuring power continuity 24/7 allowing your business to focus on its core activities.

[Learn more][232]

From project design and installation to asset care, we deliver the total solution to reduce
ambiguity.

[Learn more][233]
[Containerised Diesel Generator]

##### Manufacturing

Accelerate your project programme with our range of control panels, switchgear, and acoustic
enclosures.

[Learn more][234]

##### Service

We provide expert asset care of your gas engines, standby generators, and battery storage to
maximise plant performance and guarantee 24/7 availability.

[Learn more][235]

## Backed by Super Energy Efficiency Public ESCO

Edina and EPSL (Edina Power Service Limited) Trigeneration Pvt Ltd are owned by Super Energy Service
Company (ESCO), Energy Efficiency Services Limited (EESL), under the Ministry of Power, Government
of India.

shuffle

#### Agile scope of work

Whether you're procuring a single supply, a multi-plant configuration, or a hybrid system
integrating generation, battery storage, and balance of plant, our four decades of grid interfacing
and engineering expertise ensure your project's success.

strategy

#### Meet your strategic requirement

Our installations demonstrate some of the highest operational and availability figures in the
industry, ensuring the optimal performance of your on-site generation and battery storage asset to
maximise your return on investment.

handshake

#### Mitigate risk and expedite project delivery

Edina can deliver your engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contract and manufacturing
requirements from a single point of delivery.

A streamlined four-step process that takes you from initial consultation to generating your own

# Energy Storage Built To Your Needs

##### Customer-driven solutions

Tackling complex customer needs with a focus on flexibility.

##### Diversified across durations

Uniquely addressing short, long, and ultra long duration requirements.

##### Applying technological breadth

Unparalleled expertise across battery, gravity, hydrogen, and software.

## Reinvent energy storage with us.

Energy Vault consults closely with customers to identify, design, and construct energy storage and
power solutions that maximize the economic and environmental value of their assets.

Our customer-centric, solutions-based approach is grounded in our belief that energy storage
technologies will continue to evolve rapidly, requiring a close customer connection, technology
diversification, and sustained innovation.

[feat_list_icn1]

##### Unmatched value proposition

We are the only energy storage company offering solutions encompassing short to long to ultra long
duration needs with proprietary battery, gravity, and hybrid-hydrogen technologies.

[feat_list_icn2]

##### Sophisticated software

Our cutting-edge software helps customers orchestrate and optimize storage - and other  energy -
assets for both operational and business performance.

[feat_list_icn3]

##### Commitment to innovation

We invest strategically in research and development, knowing that the future of energy storage is
constantly being reinvented.

## Energy Vault Resiliency Center

Our focus on innovative storage solutions is exemplified by the Energy Vault Resiliency Center,
which combines proprietary gravity technology and software to optimize energy dispatch and provide
grid support.

## Our Unique Approach

What differentiates Energy Vault from our peers? It’s not one single thing, but instead a
combination of characteristics that collectively translate into greater value for our customers.

## Our Products

We design our products with a focus on scalability, flexibility, and adaptability.

### B-VAULT™

Lithium-ion battery product designed for reliability, flexibility, and availability with innovative
enclosure architecture and unique AC and DC configurations to provide customer optionality.

[ How it works ][151]

### B-Nest™

Modular, multi-story structure designed to house battery energy storage systems (BESS) for
unparalleled energy density.

[ How it works ][152]

### G-VAULT™

Family of gravity energy storage products that decouple power and energy while maintaining a high
round-trip efficiency, without the need for specific topography.

[ How it works ][153]

### H-VAULT™

Hydrogen energy storage for multi-day resilience, designed to ensure the reliability of critical
community infrastructure.

[ How it works ][154]

### VaultOS™

Energy Management Systems software providing real-time monitoring, operational control, and
optimized dispatch across an array of energy storage and generation assets.

[ How it works ][155]

### Vault-Bidder™

Advanced monetization that leverages diverse, live data from assets and external drivers to optimize
dispatch and revenue.

[ How it works ][156]

### Vault-Manager™

Asset management providing portfolio visibility, analysis, and actionable insights to improve
financial performance.

[ How it works ][157]

### Long-Term Services

Flexible and adaptable service agreements to ensure performance and availability over an asset’s
lifecycle.

[ How it works ][158]

## Reinvent energy storage with us.

Energy Vault consults closely with customers to identify, design, and construct energy storage and
power solutions that maximize the economic and environmental value of their assets.

Our customer-centric, solutions-based approach is grounded in our belief that energy storage
technologies will continue to evolve rapidly, requiring a close customer connection, technology
diversification, and sustained innovation.

# ERG Energy focuses on the R&D, production, and sales of complementary of lithium battery and flow

# Home

## Positively ingenious.

Eos is on a mission to build a future with limitless energy— with abundant energy that is reliable
enough to fuel humanity’s limitless potential. For more than 15 years, we’ve been reimagining
long-duration energy storage, applying our ingenuity to zinc-powered chemistry, high-density
configurations, and AI-enabled controls. We have created a commercially proven, U.S.-manufactured
energy storage systems designed to support resilient, dependable power where it’s needed most.

### Enable resilient, reliable energy today

ESS iron flow technology is essential to meeting near-term energy needs. Demand from AI data centers
alone is projected to increase 165% by 2030 and electricity grids around the world will need to
deploy 8 TW of long-duration energy storage (LDES) by 2040 to meet clean energy targets. As demands
on the grid continue to grow, LDES will keep the lights on. 

### Make renewable baseload energy possible

ESS solutions capture excess energy when it is available to provide uninterrupted power when it’s
not. With up to 22 hours of energy storage, ESS’ scalable, flexible solutions enable intermittent
energy to provide baseload power to meet growing energy demand from AI data centers and an
increasingly electrified society. 

### Maximize value with flexible, cost-effective solutions 

ESS’ American-made solutions are rapidly deployable, available in months instead of years. Iron flow
technology delivers unlimited cycling with zero capacity degradation over a 25-year design life. 

[Explore Products][42]

## Leading the charge

ESS continues to lead the industry with a commitment to innovation, research and development that
underpins every iron flow battery project. These awards underscore our commitment to powering data
centers, companies and communities worldwide with clean reliable energy made possible with ESS’ iron
flow technology.

# Everllence - Moving big things to zero

[ Learn more about our new name ][162]

What we do

## We provide decarbonization technologies for global shipping, energy generation, and industry

Shipping, power generation, and heavy industry produce nearly a third of the world’s carbon
emissions. These are the hardest sectors to decarbonize and the most essential to keep running.
Energy infrastructure operates at massive scale and is tightly interwoven with global supply chains.
Transforming it is complex – but it must start now. This is exactly where we come in. We develop the
technologies that make decarbonization practical and economical for the industries the world depends
on. From the engines that power global trade to the heat pumps that warm entire cities.

[Learn more about our Focus][163]

## What moves us forward

Career

### Working at Everllence

Are you looking to  leverage your existing knowledge and expertise to drive innovation? Or do you
want to  start your career with a global leader  in engineering and technology? Are you ready to
make a lasting impact as part of our team at Everllence and move big things to zero with us?

][172]
Digitalization

### Data is the future’s DNA

We at Everllence therefore enable you to increase the efficiency, reliability and maintenance of
your products. By introducing our digital key products CEON and PrimeServ Assist, we created a
comprehensive digital ecosystem that allows us to collect, combine and evaluate relevant data. This
databased ecosystem is our digital backbone and the base for new digital customer centric solutions
of the future.
[ Learn more about Digitalization at Everllence
][173]
[future-like visualization of a boat with digital components around it]

Discover Stories

## Gain deep insights into our projects

Discover Story

### From fertilizer to marine fuel

Ammonia is moving from concept to reality. In Japan, Everllence and its licensee Mitsui E&S are
testing the world's first commercial large-bore ME-LGIA engine, verifying consumption, emissions and
safety before the engine goes to sea on a bulk carrier. A decisive step toward carbon-free shipping.

[Read Story][174]

Discover Story

### Charting the IMO's course to net-zero

A one-year pause in the IMO Net-Zero Framework leaves the shipping industry without the rules it was
waiting for. Experts from Everllence and DNV explain what the framework still promises, why the
earliest entry into force is now 2028, and why the work on fuels, pricing and compliance must
continue regardless.

[Read Story][175]

# Everllence - Moving big things to zero

[ Learn more about our new name ][162]

What we do

## We provide decarbonization technologies for global shipping, energy generation, and industry

Shipping, power generation, and heavy industry produce nearly a third of the world’s carbon
emissions. These are the hardest sectors to decarbonize and the most essential to keep running.
Energy infrastructure operates at massive scale and is tightly interwoven with global supply chains.
Transforming it is complex – but it must start now. This is exactly where we come in. We develop the
technologies that make decarbonization practical and economical for the industries the world depends
on. From the engines that power global trade to the heat pumps that warm entire cities.

### From fertilizer to marine fuel

Ammonia is moving from concept to reality. In Japan, Everllence and its licensee Mitsui E&S are
testing the world's first commercial large-bore ME-LGIA engine, verifying consumption, emissions and
safety before the engine goes to sea on a bulk carrier. A decisive step toward carbon-free shipping.

### Charting the IMO's course to net-zero

A one-year pause in the IMO Net-Zero Framework leaves the shipping industry without the rules it was
waiting for. Experts from Everllence and DNV explain what the framework still promises, why the
earliest entry into force is now 2028, and why the work on fuels, pricing and compliance must
continue regardless.

## Frequently Asked Questions About EASYWAY Lithium Battery Solutions

Quick answers for distributors, installers, EPC contractors, and energy storage buyers.

Are you a manufacturer or a trading company?

We are a professional manufacturer with over 15 years of experience, specializing in LiFePO4
batteries and energy storage systems. EASYWAY is the largest lithium battery pack production base in
central China.

Do you have local warehouses in Europe or Africa?

Yes. We maintain local stock in Poland, Germany, and France for the European market. We also have
warehouses in Nigeria, including Lagos, to support faster local delivery.

What certifications do your batteries hold?

Our batteries comply with CE, including LVD, EMC, and RoHS. We also support IEC 62619, UL 1973 at
cell level, UN38.3, and MSDS requirements for safe transport.

Which inverters are your batteries compatible with?

EASYWAY batteries are officially listed compatible with Sungrow, Solis, Solinteg, and SolaX. They
also work with Deye, Growatt, Victron, SMA, GoodWe, Sofar, LuxPower, and other major brands via CAN
or RS485 communication.

What is the minimum order quantity?

For sample orders, you can start with one unit for testing. For bulk orders, quantity-based
discounts are available for distributors, EPC contractors, and project buyers.

Do you offer OEM and ODM services?

Yes. We support OEM and ODM orders, including logo, packaging, and specific technical requirements.
Our engineering team can help develop a suitable solution for your market.

### Need help choosing the right battery system?

Share your inverter brand, voltage, capacity requirement, and project location.

## Frequently Asked Questions About EASYWAY Lithium Battery Solutions

Quick answers for distributors, installers, EPC contractors, and energy storage buyers.

Are you a manufacturer or a trading company?

We are a professional manufacturer with over 15 years of experience, specializing in LiFePO4
batteries and energy storage systems. EASYWAY is the largest lithium battery pack production base in
central China.

Do you have local warehouses in Europe or Africa?

Yes. We maintain local stock in Poland, Germany, and France for the European market. We also have
warehouses in Nigeria, including Lagos, to support faster local delivery.

What certifications do your batteries hold?

Our batteries comply with CE, including LVD, EMC, and RoHS. We also support IEC 62619, UL 1973 at
cell level, UN38.3, and MSDS requirements for safe transport.

Which inverters are your batteries compatible with?

EASYWAY batteries are officially listed compatible with Sungrow, Solis, Solinteg, and SolaX. They
also work with Deye, Growatt, Victron, SMA, GoodWe, Sofar, LuxPower, and other major brands via CAN
or RS485 communication.

What is the minimum order quantity?

For sample orders, you can start with one unit for testing. For bulk orders, quantity-based
discounts are available for distributors, EPC contractors, and project buyers.

Do you offer OEM and ODM services?

Yes. We support OEM and ODM orders, including logo, packaging, and specific technical requirements.
Our engineering team can help develop a suitable solution for your market.

### Need help choosing the right battery system?

Share your inverter brand, voltage, capacity requirement, and project location.

# Energy Storage
# For a Better World

Form Energy is an American company driving innovation in energy technology and manufacturing. Our
cost-effective, multi-day energy storage solutions are designed to ensure a clean, secure, and
reliable electric grid, even during prolonged periods of stress.

### Our Technology

The electric grid faces a growing challenge: meeting rising energy demand without compromising
reliability or affordability, all while becoming cleaner. Developed and made in America, our first
commercial product is an iron-air battery capable of cost-effectively storing energy for 100 hours
at a time, directly helping to solve these grid challenges.

[ Learn More ][58]

### Manufacturing Batteries in the Heart of the Rust Belt

At Form Factory 1, Form Energy’s first high-volume battery manufacturing facility in Weirton, West
Virginia, we are helping to reignite American manufacturing. Built on the historic site of the
former Weirton Steel mill, a hallmark of the nation’s industrial heritage, our 550,000-square-foot
facility employs nearly 400 people and showcases the possibilities of American ingenuity by
producing next-generation iron-air battery systems.

[ Learn More ][59]

### About Us

Driven by Form’s core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is deeply motivated
and inspired to create a better world. We are supported by leading investors who share a common
belief that low-cost, multi-day energy storage is a key enabler of a reliable and secure electric
grid.

[ Learn More ][60]

### We're hiring

We are hiring a team of exceptionally talented and driven individuals to work at our facilities in
West Virginia, Massachusetts, and California. If you are mission-driven and want to be part of
building energy storage for a better world, we would love to hear from you!

[ Join Us ][61]

# Energy Storage
# For a Better World

Form Energy is an American company driving innovation in energy technology and manufacturing. Our
cost-effective, multi-day energy storage solutions are designed to ensure a clean, secure, and
reliable electric grid, even during prolonged periods of stress.

### Our Technology

The electric grid faces a growing challenge: meeting rising energy demand without compromising
reliability or affordability, all while becoming cleaner. Developed and made in America, our first
commercial product is an iron-air battery capable of cost-effectively storing energy for 100 hours
at a time, directly helping to solve these grid challenges.

[ Learn More ][58]

### Manufacturing Batteries in the Heart of the Rust Belt

At Form Factory 1, Form Energy’s first high-volume battery manufacturing facility in Weirton, West
Virginia, we are helping to reignite American manufacturing. Built on the historic site of the
former Weirton Steel mill, a hallmark of the nation’s industrial heritage, our 550,000-square-foot
facility employs nearly 400 people and showcases the possibilities of American ingenuity by
producing next-generation iron-air battery systems.

[ Learn More ][59]

### About Us

Driven by Form’s core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is deeply motivated
and inspired to create a better world. We are supported by leading investors who share a common
belief that low-cost, multi-day energy storage is a key enabler of a reliable and secure electric
grid.

[ Learn More ][60]

### We're hiring

We are hiring a team of exceptionally talented and driven individuals to work at our facilities in
West Virginia, Massachusetts, and California. If you are mission-driven and want to be part of
building energy storage for a better world, we would love to hear from you!

[ Join Us ][61]

## WHO WE ARE

Serving More Than 60m Global Users, Having About 1500 Employees
Genew Technologies Co., Ltd. (Stock Code: 688418), established in 2005, is a national high-tech
enterprise specializing in fundamental communication equipment R&D and industry digitalization
solutions. Our business focuses on two key sectors: public network communication for operators
(core, access, aggregation layers) and private network applications for industries (smart mining,
low-altitude economy, smart emergency response, smart petrochemicals), offering integrated solutions
from devices to platforms.
Driven by a "dual-engine" global strategy, Genew Technologies actively invests in "New Quality
Productive Forces" particularly in satellite internet. We are advancing critical technologies across
satellite, ground, and terminal segments, positioning ourselves as a global satellite communication
solution provider.

## WHO WE ARE

Serving More Than 60m Global Users, Having About 1500 Employees
Genew Technologies Co., Ltd. (Stock Code: 688418), established in 2005, is a national high-tech
enterprise specializing in fundamental communication equipment R&D and industry digitalization
solutions. Our business focuses on two key sectors: public network communication for operators
(core, access, aggregation layers) and private network applications for industries (smart mining,
low-altitude economy, smart emergency response, smart petrochemicals), offering integrated solutions
from devices to platforms.
Driven by a "dual-engine" global strategy, Genew Technologies actively invests in "New Quality
Productive Forces" particularly in satellite internet. We are advancing critical technologies across
satellite, ground, and terminal segments, positioning ourselves as a global satellite communication
solution provider.

for Global Telecom Carriers and Enterprises
Genew Technologies has launched end-to-end 5G core network solution based on the cutting-edge
technologies into market, such as atom-level convergence, cloud-native NFV, SBA, MANO based full
automation etc. Genew Technologies also has launched a new series of fixed access network products
based on the in support of the most advanced technologies, such as high-capacity uplinks (100G) and
Combo PON.

## Chris Forrest

#### HSE Director

Chris started his career in HSE while serving in the Royal Air Force, which he continued after
leaving the service and working for the Ministry of Défense, specializing in oil and gas storage and
construction.

 He left the public sector in 2012 and continued his career in the private sector, joining VTTI as
projects HSE manager, where he worked on oil and gas projects in Kenya, Cyprus, UAE, South Africa,
Croatia and Nigeria before joining GPS.

 He joined the GPS Group in December 2018 and is subsequently the HSE Director responsible for all
of the GES Group’s construction and development projects as well as providing guidance and support
to existing operations.

Chris has maintained a high level of HSE performance over the last 32 years in both the public and
private sectors, by his focus on caring about the people and their families that may be impacted by
business operations and subsequently protecting them and the organisations he represents.

[Martine][Martine]

## Martine de Beer

#### New Projects & Commercial Manager EMEA

Martine has over 15 years’ experience in various commercial and management roles within the storage
industry.

After finishing her MBA, she started as a trainee at Vopak, where she joined the Commercial team of
the Chemical Terminals in Antwerp for five years. Martine subsequently joined VTTI, being part of
the Management Team of their Amsterdam terminal and thereafter became responsible for the Commercial
and Customer Service activities in the ARA region. After five years, Martine started her own
consultancy firm. She contributed to the successful realization of several projects at Vesta
Terminals, VTTI, MarTest Cambrian and Vattenfall, ranging from operational excellence to contract
management.

Martine joined GPS in 2017 as the General Manager of the GPS Amsterdam terminal and has thereafter
fulfilled the role of New Projects and Commercial Manager EMEA for GPS, and GES since its formation.
Her areas of expertise include project sourcing and execution, including permitting, project
management and operational excellence.

[Graham Sharp][Graham Sharp]

## Graham Sharp

#### Non-Executive Director

Graham started his career in the commodities sector, first at Marc Rich and then as a co-founder of
Trafigura, where he led the oil trading team until his retirement.

 

More recently, he was a Senior VP for international trade at TNK-BP and, for eight years, Chairman
of Puma Energy. In addition to his role with GES, Graham is also a Senior Advisor to Oliver Wyman
and is an active investor in the renewable energy sector, having sat on the board of a number of
successful start-ups.

 

Graham joined as independent Non-Executive Director of GES in 2021.

[Andy][Andy]

## Andy Winser

#### Adviser

Andy holds a first class Chemical Engineering degree from the University of Birmingham. Andy has
over 40 years of oil industry experience which he started in 1975 when he joined Shell as a refinery
process engineer firstly in the UK and then in Germany.

Andy gained experience in operations, logistics and supply chain management before he moved to
Shell’s London headquarters in 1991 where he was deeply involved in Shell’s downstream strategy and
in the globalisation of supply and trading activities. In 1998 Andy joined the downstream MandA team
and was responsible for a number of multi-billion dollar deals.

For the last 7 years of his Shell career Andy led the international business development team for
Shell Trading. On retiring from Shell in 2013 Andy joined Bluewater PE as a consultant. He
co-founded GPS in 2016 and was its executive chairman until the end of 2020 when he became a
Non-Executive Director.

[Yujun][Yujun]

## Yujun Zhuang

#### Senior Financial Analyst

Yujun joined GPS Group in February 2017. Her primary responsibilities currently include financial
modelling, due diligence, and execution support for M&A activities.

Prior to joining GPS, Yujun was a Specialist with American President Lines (“APL”), where she was
involved in financial planning & analysis, due diligence, and asset management of APL’s global
operations department.

Before APL, Yujun was a Senior Executive with both global and Asia regional headquarters of NYK
Line. In NYK, she worked on global procurement and cost control, management reporting, as well as
various process optimization projects.

Yujun holds a BSc (Hons) in Maritime Studies from Nanyang Technological University. She is also a
member of the Institute of Singapore Chartered Accountants.

[Soffee][Soffee]

## Soffee Mohd

#### LNG Business Development Manager

Mohd Soffiee is an Electrical Engineer with over 40 years’ experience in Oil and Gas, mostly in LNG
and gas pipeline transmission projects. He spent over 26 years with Petronas and had also worked for
Woodside and VTTI. Soffiee joined GPS Group in June 2017 and is now supporting GES in its Asian
development efforts.

Soffiee was involved in Peninsular Gas Transmission PGU 2&3, MLNG Tiga Bintulu, Idku LNG Egypt,
Pluto LNG Australia, Iran LNG, Shell Australia (downstream assets), Ain Sokna Refrigerated LPG Egypt
and Chemaweyaat Abu Dhabi.

Martine has over 15 years’ experience in various commercial and management roles within the storage

Terminals, VTTI, MarTest Cambrian and Vattenfall, ranging from operational excellence to contract
management.

## Graham Sharp

#### Non-Executive Director

Graham started his career in the commodities sector, first at Marc Rich and then as a co-founder of
Trafigura, where he led the oil trading team until his retirement.

 

More recently, he was a Senior VP for international trade at TNK-BP and, for eight years, Chairman
of Puma Energy. In addition to his role with GES, Graham is also a Senior Advisor to Oliver Wyman
and is an active investor in the renewable energy sector, having sat on the board of a number of
successful start-ups.

 

Graham joined as independent Non-Executive Director of GES in 2021.

## Andy Winser

#### Adviser

Andy holds a first class Chemical Engineering degree from the University of Birmingham. Andy has
over 40 years of oil industry experience which he started in 1975 when he joined Shell as a refinery
process engineer firstly in the UK and then in Germany.

Andy gained experience in operations, logistics and supply chain management before he moved to
Shell’s London headquarters in 1991 where he was deeply involved in Shell’s downstream strategy and
in the globalisation of supply and trading activities. In 1998 Andy joined the downstream MandA team
and was responsible for a number of multi-billion dollar deals.

For the last 7 years of his Shell career Andy led the international business development team for
Shell Trading. On retiring from Shell in 2013 Andy joined Bluewater PE as a consultant. He
co-founded GPS in 2016 and was its executive chairman until the end of 2020 when he became a
Non-Executive Director.

modelling, due diligence, and execution support for M&A activities.

involved in financial planning & analysis, due diligence, and asset management of APL’s global
operations department.

Before APL, Yujun was a Senior Executive with both global and Asia regional headquarters of NYK
Line. In NYK, she worked on global procurement and cost control, management reporting, as well as

Yujun holds a BSc (Hons) in Maritime Studies from Nanyang Technological University. She is also a

# Charging up America’s energy future.

We strengthen America’s energy future by building and operating battery reliability projects that
store electricity to deliver when and where it’s most needed.

## The GridStor commitment.

Each of us needs reliable electricity more than ever to heat and cool our homes, run our businesses,
and communicate with each other. GridStor develops, owns, and operates grid-scale battery energy
storage systems to support a dependable power supply in the regions we serve.

##### Determined.

Our leadership team has over 200 years of combined experience in developing, building, and operating
over 100 gigawatts of power generation and storage projects.
[ Team ][15]

##### Trusted.

Our financial backing by the Sustainability and Infrastructure Investing groups of Goldman Sachs
Asset Management supports our commitment to develop and build top-tier projects.
[ Read our story ][16]

##### Diligent.

We identify the highest-benefit locations for deploying energy storage to support grid reliability.
Our projects are designed to support reliability, affordability, and sustainability goals of the
regions we serve.
[ Read more ][17]

## Batteries are key to expanding domestic energy reliance and strengthening our infrastructure.

More than ever, electric power must be available around the clock. Our economy is increasingly
dependent upon electricity to power vehicles, run new industrial facilities, support digital
commerce, and provide public services. We deploy battery energy storage to ensure stability for our
economy and communities as our electric power system grows and changes.

economy and communities as our electric power system grows and changes.
