About Us

## Who We Are —
## Hangzhou HK Charger Co., Ltd.

**Hangzhou HK Charger Co., Ltd.** is a leading manufacturer specializing in **home, commercial, and
industrial energy storage solutions**, providing innovative systems for renewable integration, load
balancing, and intelligent energy management. The company focuses on delivering reliable, efficient,
and scalable energy storage products to meet the growing demand for clean, sustainable power.

HK Charger's portfolio includes centralized and distributed storage systems, mobile and modular
battery units, and hybrid solutions that seamlessly integrate with solar, wind, and other renewable
energy sources. Each system is designed with **smart monitoring, real-time performance tracking, and
advanced load balancing capabilities**, ensuring optimal energy efficiency, cost savings, and grid
stability across various applications.

💡 Committed to sustainability and technological innovation, we empower homeowners, businesses, and
industrial operators to optimize energy usage, reduce peak demand charges, and maintain reliable
power supply even in off-grid scenarios.
[Hangzhou HK Charger Energy Storage Manufacturing Facility]
[HK Charger Intelligent Energy Management System]
Our Mission

## Driving the Future of Clean Energy

With strict adherence to international quality and safety standards, continuous R&D investment, and
a customer-focused approach, **Hangzhou HK Charger Co., Ltd.** has established itself as a trusted
**China manufacturer** in the energy storage industry.

The company's mission is to provide smart, efficient, and sustainable energy storage solutions that
empower users to integrate renewable energy, enhance operational efficiency, and contribute to a
greener future. Our intelligent energy management features include remote monitoring, predictive
maintenance, and scalable modular design.

🌱 From residential rooftop solar storage to large-scale industrial grid stabilization, HK Charger
delivers end-to-end energy storage solutions built for performance, longevity, and sustainability.
Our Factory

## World-Class Manufacturing Capabilities

Our Hangzhou production base is equipped with advanced automated assembly lines, rigorous quality
control laboratories, and dedicated R&D centers — ensuring every product meets the highest
international standards.

🏭

### 50,000 m² Production Base

Our expansive Hangzhou facility houses state-of-the-art automated production lines capable of
delivering high-volume output without compromising precision or quality.

🔬

### Advanced R&D Laboratory

Dedicated research and development teams continuously innovate new battery chemistries, BMS
algorithms, and thermal management systems to stay ahead of market demands.

✅

### Rigorous Quality Control

Every product undergoes comprehensive testing including cycle life testing, thermal shock,
overcharge protection, and IP rating validation before leaving our facility.

⚡

### Automated Assembly Lines

High-precision robotic assembly ensures consistent cell alignment, welding quality, and module
integration across all product lines, minimizing human error.

🌡️

### Thermal Management Testing

Specialized environmental chambers simulate extreme temperatures and humidity conditions to validate
product reliability across global deployment environments.

🚚

### Global Logistics Hub

Strategically located near major ports, our facility enables efficient global shipping with
professional packaging designed to protect products during international transit.

Product Portfolio

## Comprehensive Energy Storage Solutions

From residential to utility-scale, HK Charger offers a complete range of energy storage systems
engineered for performance, safety, and long-term reliability.

🏠

### Home Energy Storage Systems

Compact, wall-mounted or floor-standing residential battery systems designed to pair seamlessly with
rooftop solar installations, enabling energy independence and significant electricity bill savings.

🏢

### Commercial Energy Storage

Scalable battery storage solutions for commercial buildings, retail centers, and office complexes —
optimizing demand response, peak shaving, and time-of-use tariff management.

🏗️

### Industrial Storage Systems

High-capacity centralized and distributed storage systems for industrial facilities, manufacturing
plants, and data centers requiring uninterrupted, high-reliability power supply.

☀️

### Solar Hybrid Solutions

Integrated hybrid systems combining solar PV, wind, and battery storage with intelligent energy
management controllers for maximum renewable energy utilization and grid independence.

📦

### Modular & Mobile Units

Portable and modular battery units ideal for temporary power needs, remote sites, disaster relief
operations, and rapid-deployment energy infrastructure projects.

🔋

### Grid-Scale Storage Systems

Large-scale containerized battery energy storage systems (BESS) for utility operators, providing
frequency regulation, voltage support, and renewable energy smoothing at grid level.

Our Advantages

## Why HK Charger Stands Apart

Our competitive advantages are built on years of engineering excellence, deep industry expertise,
and an unwavering commitment to customer success.

🧠

### Smart BMS Technology

Proprietary Battery Management System with AI-driven predictive maintenance, real-time cell
balancing, and remote diagnostics for maximum system lifespan.

📡

### Remote Monitoring Platform

Cloud-based monitoring dashboard providing 24/7 visibility into system performance, energy flows,
and health status from any device, anywhere in the world.

🔧

### Modular Scalable Design

Flexible modular architecture allows systems to be easily expanded as energy demands grow,
protecting customer investment and future-proofing installations.

🌍

### Global Compliance

Products certified to CE, UL, IEC, and other major international standards, ensuring compliance and
market access in Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific regions.

Why Choose Us

## 6 Compelling Reasons to Partner with HK Charger

From product quality to after-sales support, we deliver a complete partnership experience that
drives long-term value for our customers worldwide.

01

### Proven Manufacturing Excellence

Over 15 years of specialized energy storage manufacturing experience with a track record of
delivering reliable, high-performance products to customers across 50+ countries.

02

### End-to-End R&D Capability

In-house research and development from cell selection and BMS programming to system integration and
firmware updates, ensuring continuous product improvement and innovation.

03

### Competitive Factory Pricing

As a direct manufacturer, we eliminate intermediary costs, offering highly competitive pricing
without compromising on material quality, safety standards, or performance specifications.

04

### Flexible OEM & ODM Services

Comprehensive customization capabilities including custom branding, capacity configurations,

05

### Fast Delivery & Reliable Logistics

Efficient production scheduling combined with established global logistics partnerships ensures
on-time delivery to any destination, backed by professional export packaging and documentation.

06

### Dedicated After-Sales Support

Multilingual technical support teams, comprehensive warranty programs, remote troubleshooting, and
on-site service options provide complete peace of mind throughout the product lifecycle.

Certifications & Standards

## International Quality & Safety Certifications

Our products meet the most stringent international quality and safety standards, providing customers
with confidence in compliance, performance, and market access globally.

Full compliance with European Union safety, health, and environmental protection requirements,

UL

Underwriters Laboratories certification confirming products meet rigorous North American electrical

IEC

### IEC Standards

Adherence to International Electrotechnical Commission standards including IEC 62619 for battery

ISO

### ISO 9001:2015

International quality management system certification demonstrating our systematic approach to
consistent product quality, process improvement, and customer satisfaction.

Project Cases

Real-world deployments demonstrating the performance, reliability, and versatility of HK Charger

Deployed 200+ residential energy storage systems across Germany and the Netherlands, paired with

Installed a 500 kWh commercial energy storage system for a large retail complex in Southeast Asia,

📍 Southeast Asia ⚡ 500 kWh capacity 💰 35% peak reduction

Provided a 2 MWh industrial BESS for a manufacturing facility in Australia, ensuring uninterrupted

## What We Do

IHI Terrasun maximizes your return on project investment — now, and for the long-term. 

Leveraging decades of experience in energy storage integration, IHI Terrasun creates transformative
design and service solutions for energy storage projects. We develop power plant software and
provide engineering services for the energy storage projects that we integrate into the electric
grid. Fueled by unrivaled expertise and a collaborative culture, we build long-term partnerships
that reflect our unwavering support for the growth and success of our clients.

## Innovative Solutions for Energy Storage

IHI Terrasun is at the forefront of advanced solutions for DC-coupled, collocated, and standalone
battery projects.
We build long-term partnerships that reflect our unwavering support for the growth of renewable
energy.

At IHI Terrasun, we build long-term partnerships with solar and energy storage developers to ensure
successful project commissioning and operation. Our software and comprehensive services empower
clients to achieve success in their project execution.

The IHI Terrasun team of battery energy storage experts is ready at all times to enable, support and
advance our clients’ success, whatever the challenges. That’s why customers trust us with their most
complex projects.

        #### Automotive
        
        Impro is an efficient and cost-effective one-stop solution provider with the scale and
        capability to meet the evolving needs of automotive customers.
        
        #### High Horsepower Engine
        
        Impro specializes in manufacturing mission-critical investment castings, sand castings, and
        precision machined components for high-horsepower engines.
        [High Horsepower Engine]
        
        #### Construction Equipment
        
        Impro supplies a broad range of components for construction equipment manufacturers,
        including engine fuel system parts, hydraulic system parts and transmission system parts.
        
        #### Agricultural Equipment
        
        Impro is a manufacturer and supplier of a wide variety of parts for agricultural equipment,
        including investment castings, precision machined components and sand castings for use in
        hydraulic systems, transmission systems and engines for combine harvesters, seeders and
        tractors.
        
        #### Hydraulic Equipment
        
        Impro manufactures and supplies high precision CNC machining components and investment
        castings to customers in the hydraulic equipment sector. Typical hydraulic components that
        Impro produces include custom valve spools, pump pistons, sleeves, and valve bodies.
        
        #### Aerospace
        
        At Impro, we use a variety of machining and casting techniques to produce aerospace
        components that meet industry standards and customer requirements.
        
        #### Medical
        
        Impro is a trusted partner to world-class OEMs in the medical industry for investment
        castings, sand castings and precision machined components. Our products are integrated into
        medical devices such as diagnostic equipment, surgical instruments, patient handling
        equipment and more.
        
        #### Energy
        
        Our manufacturing capabilities—including investment casting, sand casting and precision
        machining—allow us to make durable, high-quality components for the energy industry capable
        of meeting or exceeding industry standards and customer requirements.
        
        #### Other Industries
        
        Impro offers a wide array of capabilities to its customers, including investment casting,
        sand casting, precision machining, and surface treatment. No matter your industry, Impro is
        your go-to source for high-precision, high-complexity, and mission-critical components.

# [L&T Heavy Engineering Secures Global Orders, Delivers World’s Largest FCC Reactor and Key Process
# Equipment Across 5 Continents][81]

[ IndianWeb2 Desk ][82]
[Friday, July 24, 2026][83] [ No comments ][84] [0][85]
L&T Heavy Engineering, the hi-tech manufacturing arm of Larsen & Toubro, has secured a series of
international orders across Asia, Africa, North America, South America and Europe, reinforcing its
position as a global leader in process plant equipment.

The business has secured orders from Africa’s largest industrial conglomerate, Dangote Group, for a
mega refinery and multi-train fertiliser expansion projects in Nigeria and Ethiopia. The scope
includes the supply of critical process equipment, comprising the world’s largest Fluid Catalytic
Cracking Reactor Regenerator Package, all critical urea and ammonia equipment.

Additionally, the business has won a repeat order from a Japanese customer for the manufacture and
supply of Heat Exchangers and Absorbers for an LNG project in Canada. The business has also secured
orders for its core equipment including Coke Drums, Fractionator Columns and Heat Exchangers from
customers in Spain, US and Brazil.

Commenting on this, **Anil Parab, Whole-time Director & Sr Executive Vice President - Manufacturing,
L&T) **said: “These orders reaffirm the trust and confidence that customers place in L&T’s
world-class manufacturing capabilities and its consistent track record of delivering high-quality
process equipment to global clients”.

* The investment will accelerate India’s sovereign AI and data ecosystem
Further to the announcement dated July 13, 2026, relating to its proposed entry into the full-stack
AI market, HCLTech, a global technology company, today said that it plans to set-up its first AI
Data Center in the upcoming Odisha Sovereign AI Park.

The AI Data Center will be established in partnership with Sarvam and the Government of Odisha. The
planned capital outlay for the project will be Rs 14,257 crores, including financial assistance from
the Government of Odisha.

This investment will boost India’s sovereign AI play and local developer ecosystem by leveraging
HCLTech’s full-stack AI capabilities and Sarvam’s foundation models to offer sector-specific AI
applications to private and public sector enterprises and address the government’s sovereignty
needs. It will also contribute to delivery of multi-lingual AI based services to the last mile, in
line with Hon’ble Prime Minister Sh. Narendra Modi’s clarion call of AI for the benefit of everyone.

A Memorandum of Understanding to this effect was signed between HCLTech, Government of Odisha and
Sarvam in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Odisha, Sh. Mohan Charan Majhi; Dr Mukesh
Mahaling, Hon’ble Minister of Electronics and IT, Government of Odisha; Roshni Nadar Malhotra,
Chairperson, HCLTech; C Vijayakumar, CEO & MD, HCLTech and Pratyush Kumar, Co-Founder of Sarvam.

**Roshni Nadar Malhotra, Chairperson, HCLTech** commented, “HCLTech has been a flagbearer of India’s
technology industry. In line with the Digital India and Atmanirbhar Bharat vision of Hon’ble Prime
Minister Sh. Narendra Modi, we strive to be an enabler of India's sovereign AI ecosystem with
differentiated offerings across the value chain through focused investments and partnerships. We are
pleased to start this endeavor in partnership with Odisha government and Sarvam.”

“This is an important milestone in our full-stack AI play and will enable us to serve the large
demand for sovereign AI solutions and unlock the scale of our strategic partnership with Sarvam.
Odisha offers a progressive policy environment backed by excellent infrastructure and we look
forward to working with them in collaboration with Sarvam, added **C Vijayakumar, CEO & Managing
Director, HCLTech.
**
According to **Pratyush Kumar, Co-Founder, Sarvam, **“The Odisha Sovereign AI Park will connect
high-performance compute with Indian models and real-world applications. Together with HCLTech, we
are excited to bring Sarvam’s full-stack AI capabilities to enterprises and public systems at
scale.”

India is among the fastest growing technology markets globally and a growth market for HCLTech. The
country’s data center ecosystem is on a rapid growth trajectory, driven by strong demand from a
vibrant digital economy, data localization and critical infrastructure needs to support GPU
deployments for AI training and inference workloads.

and we look forward to developing Bhubaneshwar as one of our key global innovation and delivery
hubs.”

HCLTech’s decision to establish their footprint in Odisha. Their presence will further embellish
Bhubaneshwar’s status as one of India’s most promising technology hubs.”

### How does the Load Calculator work?

The [Livguard Load Calculator][116] is a personalised Load Calculator that suggests you the best
Livguard Inverter and Inverter Battery based on devices you choose, backup hours needed, and average
power use. It guarantees reliable power backup solution for your home.

### What is an inverter load calculator?

An electrical load capacity calculator is a digital tool that helps determine the total power
requirement of your appliances, guiding you to select the right inverter and battery setup.

### How do I calculate the load for my home inverter?

List all appliances you want to run during a power cut, note their wattage, and multiply each by
usage hours. Add the totals to get your home inverter load.

### Why is load calculation important for inverter selection?

The office or home power load calculator ensures your inverter can handle your power needs
efficiently, prevents overload, avoids performance issues, and helps in choosing a suitable battery
for longer backup.

### Can I use an inverter calculator for both home and office setups?

Yes, an inverter office or home generator load calculator works for both homes and offices. It
allows you to input appliance wattage and usage patterns to help you choose the correct capacity
based on your demands.

### Can I use the electricity load calculator for a generator?

Yes, an office or household load calculator can also estimate generator requirements by summing up
the wattage of devices you plan to run during power outages or off-grid situations.

### What happens if my electrical load exceeds the inverter's capacity?

Exceeding your inverter's capacity may lead to overload shutdowns, reduced performance, or even
system damage. It’s essential to match your inverter size to your actual energy needs.

### What is the difference between load calculation for UPS and inverters?

UPS load calculation is different from inverter load calculation. UPS load calculation is based on
the power consumption of the devices connected to it, while inverter load calculation is based on
the power consumption of the devices connected to the inverter.

# About Our Company

Lvwo Energy Technology Co., Ltd is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the R&D, production, sales
of LiFePO4 cells and PACK assembly and energy storage system.

Battery Packs produced by Lvwo Energy are widely used in intelligent battery swapping stations,
communication backup power, home energy storage system, portable power supply, solar street light,
energy storage system and other essential fields.

Our company fully supports the exclusive customization of battery packs for precisely meeting your
diverse needs.

Lvwo lithium battery packs are widely used in solar street lights, emergency lights, highway safety
indicators, solar cameras, etc., with ultra-long life. Buy once, benefit for life.
[More About Us][103]

Backup Power Supply
The power supply system necessary to maintain the normal operation of communication base stations.
Plug-in box design, easy to install and maintain. Chassis design, supports series and parallel
connection.

The most perfect energy storage solution for wind and solar energy. Data visualization; refined and
intelligent device management. Frequency modulation; Peak shaving; Cross-regional collaborative
operation; Cost reduction and efficiency improvement.

Industrial and Commercial Battery Energy Storage
Essential energy storage system for industry and commerce. New Air-cooling and Liquid-cooling
technology ensures power supply, optimizes power quality, utilizes peak and valley electricity
prices, and connects to new energy sources.

Home Energy Storage System
There are many models to choose from, such as wall-mounted, stacked, and photovoltaic all-in-one.
Compact design to saves space and electricity costs. Remote mobile monitoring, safe and intelligent.
Also can be connected to solar panels.

Lvwo lithium battery can perfectly replace lead-acid battery, achieving portable size and weight,
longer endurance and life. Widely used in RVs, ships, forklifts, AGVs, golf carts, outdoor sports,
and adventures.
[More About Us][108]
[solution]
Mobile EV Charging Station
Lvwo mobile charging vehicles are used as energy storage or emergency power supply for charging
anytime, anywhere, perfect mobile power station.

Lvwo's well-designed LiFePO4 battery packs are tailor-made for golf carts, forklifts, cleaning
trucks, logistics trucks and sightseeing trucks, and other low-speed transport vehicles, which
comprehensively cover the needs of diversified application scenarios.
[More About Us][110]
[solution]
New Energy Vehicle Battery
In the field of new energy vehicle batteries, the batteries manufactured by Lvwo are mainly used in
buses, light trucks, heavy trucks, logistics vehicles and other fields to achieve green
transportation within cities.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Can I use this with my own hardware?

The full source code (software, firmware, CAD files) is provided after purchasing the hardware kit.
Email your order confirmation to [service@nenpower.com][18] and we will send you access. You will
need to calibrate mechanical parameters if using custom hardware.

What's the actual precision I can expect?

Typical precision is ±0.1mm with proper calibration, thanks to 16-microstep drivers and 4.5:1 gear
ratio. Repeatability is excellent (~0.05mm). Absolute accuracy depends on calibration quality and
mechanical tolerances.

Do I need robotics experience?

Basic programming knowledge helps, but not required. Our documentation includes step-by-step
tutorials from beginner to advanced. If you can install Python and follow instructions, you can get
this running.

Can I train my own object detection model?

Yes! We provide labelImg tool for data annotation and complete instructions for YOLOv8 training. The
Complete Solution kit includes one custom model training service from our team.

What OS is supported?

Primary support is Windows 10/11 (tested). Linux compatibility is good (Ubuntu 20.04+). macOS should
work but is untested. All Python dependencies are cross-platform.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Can I use this with my own hardware?

The full source code (software, firmware, CAD files) is provided after purchasing the hardware kit.
Email your order confirmation to [service@nenpower.com][18] and we will send you access. You will
need to calibrate mechanical parameters if using custom hardware.

What's the actual precision I can expect?

Typical precision is ±0.1mm with proper calibration, thanks to 16-microstep drivers and 4.5:1 gear
ratio. Repeatability is excellent (~0.05mm). Absolute accuracy depends on calibration quality and
mechanical tolerances.

Do I need robotics experience?

Basic programming knowledge helps, but not required. Our documentation includes step-by-step
tutorials from beginner to advanced. If you can install Python and follow instructions, you can get
this running.

Can I train my own object detection model?

Yes! We provide labelImg tool for data annotation and complete instructions for YOLOv8 training. The
Complete Solution kit includes one custom model training service from our team.

What OS is supported?

Primary support is Windows 10/11 (tested). Linux compatibility is good (Ubuntu 20.04+). macOS should
work but is untested. All Python dependencies are cross-platform.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Who are the top lithium-ion battery manufacturers in India?

Leading manufacturers include Neuron Energy, Exide, Amara Raja, and other emerging players in the EV
and energy storage space.


### What factors should I consider when choosing a lithium-ion battery manufacturer?

Focus on battery capacity, safety features, certifications, cycle life, warranty, and after-sales
support.


### Are lithium-ion batteries made in India reliable?

Yes. Reputed manufacturers like Neuron Energy offer globally benchmarked batteries engineered for
performance and safety.


### What are the applications of lithium-ion batteries?

They are widely used in electric vehicles (EVs), solar energy storage, industrial backup systems,
and portable electronics.


### How much do lithium-ion batteries cost in India?

Costs vary depending on battery size, technology, and use case. Prices range from affordable EV
batteries to premium industrial solutions.


### Why choose Neuron Energy for lithium-ion batteries?

We combine cutting-edge technology with Indian engineering expertise to deliver efficient, safe, and
durable batteries for EVs, solar storage, and more.

### What types of lithium-ion batteries does Neuron Energy offer?

We provide batteries for electric two-wheelers, three-wheelers, LCVs, solar storage, and custom
energy solutions for industrial applications.


### Are Neuron Energy’s lithium-ion batteries safe?

Yes. Our batteries feature intelligent Battery Management Systems (BMS), advanced thermal
protection, and rigorous safety protocols.

### Does Neuron Energy provide warranty and after-sales support?

Absolutely. We offer comprehensive warranties and responsive service support to ensure long-term
performance and customer satisfaction.


### Where can I buy Neuron Energy’s lithium-ion batteries?

You can purchase our batteries through our website, authorized dealers, and distribution partners
across India.


Neuron Energy is proud to be recognized among India’s trusted lithium-ion battery manufacturers,
delivering solutions designed for India's unique conditions — from rugged roads to high
temperatures. Our focus on innovation, quality, and sustainability has made us a preferred choice
for OEMs, fleet operators, and renewable energy providers across the country.

manufacturing located in Canada.

[ Learn More  about North-American Design & Manufacturing ][43]

## Stem and Nuvation Energy Enter into Agreement to Deliver North American-Made BESS Control
## Solution

As demand for secure, compliant energy infrastructure accelerates, developers are looking for
solutions that deliver both performance and transparency from the ground up. This announcement
highlights a new collaboration between Stem, Inc. and Nuvation Energy, combining PowerTrack™ EMS
with Nuvation’s BMS to deliver a fully North American-made control solution.

[ LEARN MORE  about Stem and Nuvation Energy Enter into Agreement to Deliver North American-Made
BESS Control Solution ][44]

## Webinar: Grid Security in Battery Energy Storage and Power Resiliency Applications

Join Michael Worry, CEO & CTO of Nuvation Energy, and James Richmond, CEO & Founder of e2Companies
for an exploration of how energy storage system integrators are delivering solutions that balance
domestic sourcing requirements against global supply chain dependencies.

[ WATCH NOW  about Webinar: Grid Security in Battery Energy Storage and Power Resiliency
Applications ][45]

## Honeywell Ionic™

management system (BMS) into Honeywell’s modular battery energy storage system, Honeywell Ionic™.

[ LEARN MORE  about Honeywell Collaborates with Nuvation Energy to Add Flexible Battery Management
System to Honeywell Ionic™ ][46]

Nuvation Energy solutions have been deployed in energy storage projects around the world, supporting
applications ranging from utility-scale grid infrastructure to marine, aerospace, and defense
systems.

NWI connects manufacturer access with the operational details each market requires: homologation,
import, fleet and retail sales, charging network planning, solar and storage projects, marketing,
warranty, parts and service.

### Manufacturer access

Direct coordination with brand principals for catalogue planning, product information, commercial
priorities and technical standards across vehicles, trucks, buses, machinery, professional tools, EV
charging and solar storage systems.

### Homologation and market entry

Support for market requirements, homologation steps, technical documentation and regulatory
coordination for mobility, industrial equipment, EV charging, solar PV, battery storage and energy
solutions in Cuba and Canada.

### Import and logistics

Operational support for import planning, unit, equipment, tool, charging, solar and energy storage
availability, parts coordination, documentation and delivery continuity.

### B2B, fleet and retail sales

Commercial support for business clients, fleet opportunities, institutional needs, individual
customers, tool distribution, charging networks, solar storage projects and channel relationships.

#### About Us

## Meet OGO Energy

## Charge. Connect. Grow.

OGO(On-the-go) Energy, we are committed to transforming and decarbonising the environment through
our **Make in India initiative.** We design and develop advanced battery energy storage systems
(BESS) for both stationary and electric mobility applications. Our lithium-ion battery packs are
manufactured in-house, powered by our **indigenously developed Battery Management System (BMS).**

OGO Energy strives to be a leading provider of lithium-ion cell-based energy storage solutions. As a
**cell-to-container (C2C) system integrator,** we have the capability to build a significant portion
of the battery pack value chain.

Our strong **R&D foundation** and commitment to accelerating battery adoption in emerging markets
drive our innovation and impact.

  #### UPS电源为代表的工业级及汽车级应用领域，以及以PC电源、适配器、TV电源板、手机快速充电器、电磁加
  #### 热为代表的消费电子应用领域。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][20]
  
  ### SJ MOSFETs
  
  #### 为适应电源系统高效率小型化的需求，东微半导体推出了新型的GreenMOS系列高压MOSFET,
  #### 采用独特专利器件结构和制造工艺，GreenMOS产品具有比常规MOSFET更快的开关速度及更柔和的开关曲线
  #### ，在获得极低的动态损耗的同时最大限度抑制了开关震荡，不仅可以大大提高系统效率、降低发热量，还
  #### 可以简化系统EMI设计。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][21]
  
  ### SGT MOSFETs
  
  #### 东微的SFGMOS系列MOSFET产品采用半浮栅结构，兼备了传统平面结构和SGT结构的功率MOSFET的优点，并具
  #### 有更高的工艺稳定性和可靠性及更快的开关速度、更小的栅电荷和更高的应用效率等优点。SFGMOS系列MOS
  #### FET产品涵盖20V~200V全系列，可广泛应用于电机驱动、同步整流等领域中。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][22]
  
  ### IGBTs
  
  #### 东微的IGBT芯片采用特有的Trident-Gate Bipolar Transistor
  #### (TGBT)器件结构，以得到更低的导通压降与更小的开关损耗。目前公司已先后推出第一代及第二代TGBT多
  #### 个系列产品，涵盖600V~1700V电压，适合应用于光伏储能逆变、直流充电桩、汽车主驱、OBC、UPS等领域
  #### 。公司亦开发出超高速系列TGBT，工作频率达到60-100KHz，可以在满足电源系统进一步高频化的同时，实
  #### 现更高的效率。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][23]
  
  ### Trench MOSFETs
  
  #### 沟槽Trench
  #### MOSFET：性能可靠，值得信赖，通过大量的开发，我们持续不断地利用先进的小信号MOS和功率MOS解决方
  #### 案扩充我们的产品组合。我们种类齐全的产品组合提供当今市场所需的灵活性，让您可以轻松选择最适合
  #### 您系统的产品。我们的领先技术确保提供最高的可靠性和性能，而先进的封装则可以增强电阻和热性能，
  #### 同时缩小尺寸，降低成本。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][24]
  
  ### Power Module
  
  #### 先进的电源模块, 包括
  #### IGBT、MOSFET、SiC、Si/SiC混合模块、二极管、SiC二极管和智能功率模块。IGBT模块被运用于主驱和DC-
  #### AC级太阳能逆变器、能源储存系统、不间断电源和电机驱动等应用中。MOSFET模块用于汽车电机驱动和车
  #### 载充电机应用，额定电压可选40 V、60 V、80 V和650 V，采用超级结技术和感应电阻。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][25]
  
  ### SiC MOSFETs
  
  #### 第三代半导体材料功率器件是未来高性能功率器件的重要组成部分之一。东微研发团队在宽禁带半导体研
  #### 究上有丰富的经验，研发了一系列SiC MOSFETs。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][26]
  
  ### GaN HEMT
  
  #### 氮化镓高电子迁移率晶体管（GaN
  #### HEMT）正日益成为主流市场的选择。针对各种高电压和低电压应用场景，GaN
  #### HEMT具备最快的转换/开关能力（最高dv/dt与di/dt）和最优异的能效表现。此外，东微半导体自研的GaN
  #### HEMT通过新颖的设计，降低导通损耗和开关损耗，进一步提升了功率密度。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][27]
  
  ### Power IC
  
  #### 针对高端AC-DC、DC-DC工业电源及AI算力电源核心应用场景，东微持续迭代并推出数字专用电源控制IC，
  #### 全面适配高频宽禁带功率器件与高密度电源架构。相较于传统模拟电源IC，数字专用控制IC具备颠覆性优
  #### 势，摒弃了模拟方案依赖阻容参数定标、调试繁琐、方案固化的痛点，实现重要参数数字化可配置，可灵
  #### 活调校环路补偿、工作拓扑模式、各类保护阈值及轻载节能策略，无需更改硬件电路即可适配多规格电源
  #### 产品。同时芯片动态自适应能力更强，可针对负载突变、电网波动、高低温工况自动优化控制逻辑，大幅
  #### 提升电源瞬态响应与全负载段能效；有效解决模拟IC固有的温漂、器件离散性问题，整机批量一致性大幅
  #### 提升，量产良率更高；且集成高精度采样、智能故障保护、自适应算法等核心功能，外围器件极简，集成
  #### 度远高于传统模拟方案，有效简化客户硬件设计与调试流程。相较于通用MCU、DSP控制方案，数字专用控
  #### 制IC优势同样突出，专用硬件控制架构无需软件代码开发、无程序编译调试门槛，客户入门难度低、项目
  #### 落地周期大幅缩短；芯片架构精简、成本可控，相比高端DSP主控具备显著成本优势；纯硬件闭环控制无软
  #### 件冗余功耗，待机功耗更低，适配电源低功耗能效规范；同时抗EMI干扰能力强，在高频、高压、强干扰的
  #### 严苛电源工况下，可靠性与稳定性更高，完美匹配高端工业电源、AI数据中心电源的高可靠、高效率、低
  #### 成本量产需求。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][28]
  
  ### LDO
  
  #### LDO（Low Dropout Regulator
  #### 低压差线性稳压器）为适应从便携式设备到工业高压控制对电源管理的多元化需求，东微推出了全系列高
  #### 性能LDO产品线。该系列包含超低功耗的CMOS架构与高可靠性的Bipolar架构，采用先进的带隙基准源与过
  #### 流保护技术，具有比传统稳压器更宽的输入电压窗口及极高的性价比。CMOS系列实现了低至0.2μA的静态电
  #### 流与高达90dB的电源抑制比，而Bipolar系列则支持高达1.5A的大电流输出与36V以上的耐高压特性，在确
  #### 保输出电压精度的同时大幅简化了外围电路设计。
  #### 该系列产品涵盖5.5V至100V全电压输入范围，提供从100mA到1.5A的多种电流规格，封装形式灵活多样（SO
  #### T23/SOT89/SOT223/TO252等），可以满足各种复杂系统的供电需求。基于其低功耗、高耐压及低噪声的特
  #### 点，特别适用于智能电表、48V轻混系统、安防监控、电机驱动、物联网节点及各类精密仪器等系统。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][29]
  
  ### OPA
  
  #### OPA（Operational Amplifier
  #### 运算放大器）为应对现代电子系统对低功耗、高精度及高速信号处理的严苛挑战，东微推出了全系列高性
  #### 能模拟信号链产品。该系列涵盖低压通用运放、高压通用运放、低压高速运放及低压比较器四大核心品类
  #### ，采用先进的半导体制造工艺与优化的内部拓扑架构，具有比传统同类产品更宽的电源电压范围、极低的
  #### 输入失调电压（Vos）以及卓越的电源抑制比（PSRR）。其中，低压通用系列实现了低至50μA的静态功耗与
  #### 轨到轨（Rail-to-Rail）输入输出特性；高速系列则具备高达250MHz的增益带宽积与180V/μs的压摆率，在
  #### 确保极低噪声的同时大幅提升了系统的动态响应能力。
  #### 该系列产品提供从单通道到四通道的丰富规格矩阵，支持SOT23、MSOP、DFN等多种微型封装形式，可完美
  #### 替代市场主流竞品。基于其高可靠性、低失真及优异的抗干扰性能，特别适用于工业控制、汽车电子、医
  #### 疗仪器、通信设备、精密数据采集及物联网传感器等多元化应用场景。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][30]
  
  ### DSP
  
  #### 我司 DSP 产品聚焦芯片正向设计，自主掌握 DSP 处理器内核及全部外设模块 IP 源代码，长期沉淀 IP
  #### 核、设计流程、自动化脚本、芯片架构等海量设计资源，核心 IP 可实现全流程自主开发。围绕 DSP
  #### 芯片设计关键技术，产品已经累计申请发明专利 11 项（已授权 4 项）、软件著作权 17
  #### 项、集成电路布图 3 项，并且产品以量产且服务多家国内知名企业。产品对标国际头部厂商主流 DSP
  #### 芯片，广泛应用于电源控制、电机驱动、工业网络等领域，旨在破解国内 DSP
  #### 芯片高度依赖进口的行业痛点，在满足客户性能需求前提下推进核心器件国产替代与自主可控。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][31]
  应用领域
  **应用领域**
  东微半导体的产品应用领域广泛且具体。在汽车电子方面，深度布局电动化，涵盖车载充电、各类电控系统及热
  管理；在工业与能源领域，提供电池测试、光伏逆变及工业电源解决方案；同时，其产品也服务于消费电子
  （如快充、电视）、家用电器（如冰箱、吸尘器）、通信设施（如数据中心电源）以及电机驱动
  （如机器人、无人机、叉车）等多个关键行业。 [

  #### 低压差线性稳压器）为适应从便携式设备到工业高压控制对电源管理的多元化需求，东微推出了全系列高
  #### 性能LDO产品线。该系列包含超低功耗的CMOS架构与高可靠性的Bipolar架构，采用先进的带隙基准源与过
  #### 流保护技术，具有比传统稳压器更宽的输入电压窗口及极高的性价比。CMOS系列实现了低至0.2μA的静态电
  #### 流与高达90dB的电源抑制比，而Bipolar系列则支持高达1.5A的大电流输出与36V以上的耐高压特性，在确
  #### 保输出电压精度的同时大幅简化了外围电路设计。
  #### 该系列产品涵盖5.5V至100V全电压输入范围，提供从100mA到1.5A的多种电流规格，封装形式灵活多样（SO
  #### T23/SOT89/SOT223/TO252等），可以满足各种复杂系统的供电需求。基于其低功耗、高耐压及低噪声的特
  #### 点，特别适用于智能电表、48V轻混系统、安防监控、电机驱动、物联网节点及各类精密仪器等系统。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][29]
  
  ### OPA
  
  #### OPA（Operational Amplifier
  #### 运算放大器）为应对现代电子系统对低功耗、高精度及高速信号处理的严苛挑战，东微推出了全系列高性
  #### 能模拟信号链产品。该系列涵盖低压通用运放、高压通用运放、低压高速运放及低压比较器四大核心品类
  #### ，采用先进的半导体制造工艺与优化的内部拓扑架构，具有比传统同类产品更宽的电源电压范围、极低的
  #### 输入失调电压（Vos）以及卓越的电源抑制比（PSRR）。其中，低压通用系列实现了低至50μA的静态功耗与
  #### 轨到轨（Rail-to-Rail）输入输出特性；高速系列则具备高达250MHz的增益带宽积与180V/μs的压摆率，在
  #### 确保极低噪声的同时大幅提升了系统的动态响应能力。
  #### 该系列产品提供从单通道到四通道的丰富规格矩阵，支持SOT23、MSOP、DFN等多种微型封装形式，可完美
  #### 替代市场主流竞品。基于其高可靠性、低失真及优异的抗干扰性能，特别适用于工业控制、汽车电子、医
  #### 疗仪器、通信设备、精密数据采集及物联网传感器等多元化应用场景。

  ### DSP
  
  #### 我司 DSP 产品聚焦芯片正向设计，自主掌握 DSP 处理器内核及全部外设模块 IP 源代码，长期沉淀 IP
  #### 核、设计流程、自动化脚本、芯片架构等海量设计资源，核心 IP 可实现全流程自主开发。围绕 DSP
  #### 芯片设计关键技术，产品已经累计申请发明专利 11 项（已授权 4 项）、软件著作权 17
  #### 项、集成电路布图 3 项，并且产品以量产且服务多家国内知名企业。产品对标国际头部厂商主流 DSP
  #### 芯片，广泛应用于电源控制、电机驱动、工业网络等领域，旨在破解国内 DSP
  #### 芯片高度依赖进口的行业痛点，在满足客户性能需求前提下推进核心器件国产替代与自主可控。

  #### 采用独特专利器件结构和制造工艺，GreenMOS产品具有比常规MOSFET更快的开关速度及更柔和的开关曲线
  #### ，在获得极低的动态损耗的同时最大限度抑制了开关震荡，不仅可以大大提高系统效率、降低发热量，还

  ### SGT MOSFETs
  
  #### 东微的SFGMOS系列MOSFET产品采用半浮栅结构，兼备了传统平面结构和SGT结构的功率MOSFET的优点，并具
  #### 有更高的工艺稳定性和可靠性及更快的开关速度、更小的栅电荷和更高的应用效率等优点。SFGMOS系列MOS
  #### FET产品涵盖20V~200V全系列，可广泛应用于电机驱动、同步整流等领域中。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][22]
  
  ### IGBTs
  
  #### 东微的IGBT芯片采用特有的Trident-Gate Bipolar Transistor
  #### (TGBT)器件结构，以得到更低的导通压降与更小的开关损耗。目前公司已先后推出第一代及第二代TGBT多
  #### 个系列产品，涵盖600V~1700V电压，适合应用于光伏储能逆变、直流充电桩、汽车主驱、OBC、UPS等领域
  #### 。公司亦开发出超高速系列TGBT，工作频率达到60-100KHz，可以在满足电源系统进一步高频化的同时，实
  #### 现更高的效率。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][23]
  
  ### Trench MOSFETs
  
  #### 沟槽Trench
  #### MOSFET：性能可靠，值得信赖，通过大量的开发，我们持续不断地利用先进的小信号MOS和功率MOS解决方
  #### 案扩充我们的产品组合。我们种类齐全的产品组合提供当今市场所需的灵活性，让您可以轻松选择最适合
  #### 您系统的产品。我们的领先技术确保提供最高的可靠性和性能，而先进的封装则可以增强电阻和热性能，
  #### 同时缩小尺寸，降低成本。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][24]
  
  ### Power Module
  
  #### 先进的电源模块, 包括
  #### IGBT、MOSFET、SiC、Si/SiC混合模块、二极管、SiC二极管和智能功率模块。IGBT模块被运用于主驱和DC-
  #### AC级太阳能逆变器、能源储存系统、不间断电源和电机驱动等应用中。MOSFET模块用于汽车电机驱动和车
  #### 载充电机应用，额定电压可选40 V、60 V、80 V和650 V，采用超级结技术和感应电阻。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][25]
  
  ### SiC MOSFETs
  
  #### 第三代半导体材料功率器件是未来高性能功率器件的重要组成部分之一。东微研发团队在宽禁带半导体研
  #### 究上有丰富的经验，研发了一系列SiC MOSFETs。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][26]
  
  ### GaN HEMT
  
  #### 氮化镓高电子迁移率晶体管（GaN
  #### HEMT）正日益成为主流市场的选择。针对各种高电压和低电压应用场景，GaN
  #### HEMT具备最快的转换/开关能力（最高dv/dt与di/dt）和最优异的能效表现。此外，东微半导体自研的GaN
  #### HEMT通过新颖的设计，降低导通损耗和开关损耗，进一步提升了功率密度。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][27]
  
  ### Power IC
  
  #### 针对高端AC-DC、DC-DC工业电源及AI算力电源核心应用场景，东微持续迭代并推出数字专用电源控制IC，
  #### 全面适配高频宽禁带功率器件与高密度电源架构。相较于传统模拟电源IC，数字专用控制IC具备颠覆性优
  #### 势，摒弃了模拟方案依赖阻容参数定标、调试繁琐、方案固化的痛点，实现重要参数数字化可配置，可灵
  #### 活调校环路补偿、工作拓扑模式、各类保护阈值及轻载节能策略，无需更改硬件电路即可适配多规格电源
  #### 产品。同时芯片动态自适应能力更强，可针对负载突变、电网波动、高低温工况自动优化控制逻辑，大幅
  #### 提升电源瞬态响应与全负载段能效；有效解决模拟IC固有的温漂、器件离散性问题，整机批量一致性大幅
  #### 提升，量产良率更高；且集成高精度采样、智能故障保护、自适应算法等核心功能，外围器件极简，集成
  #### 度远高于传统模拟方案，有效简化客户硬件设计与调试流程。相较于通用MCU、DSP控制方案，数字专用控
  #### 制IC优势同样突出，专用硬件控制架构无需软件代码开发、无程序编译调试门槛，客户入门难度低、项目
  #### 落地周期大幅缩短；芯片架构精简、成本可控，相比高端DSP主控具备显著成本优势；纯硬件闭环控制无软
  #### 件冗余功耗，待机功耗更低，适配电源低功耗能效规范；同时抗EMI干扰能力强，在高频、高压、强干扰的
  #### 严苛电源工况下，可靠性与稳定性更高，完美匹配高端工业电源、AI数据中心电源的高可靠、高效率、低
  #### 成本量产需求。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][28]
  
  ### LDO
  
  #### LDO（Low Dropout Regulator
  #### 低压差线性稳压器）为适应从便携式设备到工业高压控制对电源管理的多元化需求，东微推出了全系列高
  #### 性能LDO产品线。该系列包含超低功耗的CMOS架构与高可靠性的Bipolar架构，采用先进的带隙基准源与过
  #### 流保护技术，具有比传统稳压器更宽的输入电压窗口及极高的性价比。CMOS系列实现了低至0.2μA的静态电
  #### 流与高达90dB的电源抑制比，而Bipolar系列则支持高达1.5A的大电流输出与36V以上的耐高压特性，在确
  #### 保输出电压精度的同时大幅简化了外围电路设计。
  #### 该系列产品涵盖5.5V至100V全电压输入范围，提供从100mA到1.5A的多种电流规格，封装形式灵活多样（SO
  #### T23/SOT89/SOT223/TO252等），可以满足各种复杂系统的供电需求。基于其低功耗、高耐压及低噪声的特
  #### 点，特别适用于智能电表、48V轻混系统、安防监控、电机驱动、物联网节点及各类精密仪器等系统。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][29]
  
  ### OPA
  
  #### OPA（Operational Amplifier
  #### 运算放大器）为应对现代电子系统对低功耗、高精度及高速信号处理的严苛挑战，东微推出了全系列高性
  #### 能模拟信号链产品。该系列涵盖低压通用运放、高压通用运放、低压高速运放及低压比较器四大核心品类
  #### ，采用先进的半导体制造工艺与优化的内部拓扑架构，具有比传统同类产品更宽的电源电压范围、极低的
  #### 输入失调电压（Vos）以及卓越的电源抑制比（PSRR）。其中，低压通用系列实现了低至50μA的静态功耗与
  #### 轨到轨（Rail-to-Rail）输入输出特性；高速系列则具备高达250MHz的增益带宽积与180V/μs的压摆率，在
  #### 确保极低噪声的同时大幅提升了系统的动态响应能力。
  #### 该系列产品提供从单通道到四通道的丰富规格矩阵，支持SOT23、MSOP、DFN等多种微型封装形式，可完美
  #### 替代市场主流竞品。基于其高可靠性、低失真及优异的抗干扰性能，特别适用于工业控制、汽车电子、医
  #### 疗仪器、通信设备、精密数据采集及物联网传感器等多元化应用场景。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][30]
  
  ### DSP
  
  #### 我司 DSP 产品聚焦芯片正向设计，自主掌握 DSP 处理器内核及全部外设模块 IP 源代码，长期沉淀 IP
  #### 核、设计流程、自动化脚本、芯片架构等海量设计资源，核心 IP 可实现全流程自主开发。围绕 DSP
  #### 芯片设计关键技术，产品已经累计申请发明专利 11 项（已授权 4 项）、软件著作权 17
  #### 项、集成电路布图 3 项，并且产品以量产且服务多家国内知名企业。产品对标国际头部厂商主流 DSP
  #### 芯片，广泛应用于电源控制、电机驱动、工业网络等领域，旨在破解国内 DSP
  #### 芯片高度依赖进口的行业痛点，在满足客户性能需求前提下推进核心器件国产替代与自主可控。
  
  [
  探索更多
  ][31]
  应用领域
  **应用领域**
  东微半导体的产品应用领域广泛且具体。在汽车电子方面，深度布局电动化，涵盖车载充电、各类电控系统及热
  管理；在工业与能源领域，提供电池测试、光伏逆变及工业电源解决方案；同时，其产品也服务于消费电子
  （如快充、电视）、家用电器（如冰箱、吸尘器）、通信设施（如数据中心电源）以及电机驱动
  （如机器人、无人机、叉车）等多个关键行业。 [

About EnerNova

## Hangzhou EnerNova Charger Co., Ltd.

**Hangzhou EnerNova Charger Co., Ltd.** is a leading innovator in the field of electric vehicle
charging and smart energy solutions. Specializing in both AC and DC EV charging technologies, the
company provides a comprehensive range of products and services designed to meet the diverse needs
of residential, commercial, and fleet customers.

EnerNova's portfolio includes home EV chargers, fast DC charging stations, intelligent charging
power management systems, and advanced energy storage solutions. By integrating cutting-edge
hardware with smart software, the company ensures optimized charging efficiency, real-time
monitoring, and reliable energy management for all applications.

💡 Committed to sustainability and the development of green transportation — seamlessly integrating
renewable energy with EV charging infrastructure.

Committed to sustainability and the development of green transportation, Hangzhou EnerNova
emphasizes seamless integration of renewable energy sources with its charging and storage systems.
Its solutions support vehicle-to-grid (V2G) applications, load balancing, and intelligent energy
optimization, helping customers reduce operational costs while enhancing grid stability.

With rigorous quality standards, continuous R&D investment, and a customer-centric approach,
EnerNova has established itself as a trusted partner in the EV and smart energy industry. The
company's innovative technologies empower users to adopt cleaner, smarter, and more efficient energy
solutions, paving the way for the future of intelligent mobility.

## Comprehensive EV Charging Solutions

From residential home chargers to high-power commercial DC fast chargers — EnerNova delivers
end-to-end smart charging ecosystems.

⚡

### Home AC EV Chargers

Compact, smart, and Wi-Fi enabled Level 2 home charging units supporting 7.4kW to 22kW output.
Compatible with all major EV brands and integrated with mobile app control for scheduling and energy
tracking.

Residential
🔋

### DC Fast Charging Stations

High-performance DC fast chargers from 30kW to 360kW, designed for commercial parking, highways, and
fleet depots. Multi-connector support (CCS1, CCS2, CHAdeMO, GB/T) ensures universal compatibility.

Commercial
🧠

### Intelligent Power Management

Advanced OCPP-compliant charging management software with real-time load balancing, dynamic pricing,
remote diagnostics, and multi-site fleet management capabilities for enterprise operators.

Software
🌐

### V2G Bidirectional Chargers

Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) enabled chargers that allow EVs to feed energy back to the grid, supporting
demand response programs and providing grid stability services for utilities and prosumers.

V2G / Smart Grid
☀️

### Energy Storage Systems

Modular battery energy storage solutions (BESS) that integrate with solar PV and EV charging
infrastructure, enabling peak shaving, off-grid operation, and renewable energy maximization.

Energy Storage

### Fleet & Commercial Charging

Scalable charging infrastructure for commercial fleets including buses, logistics vehicles, and
ride-sharing operators. Features depot management systems, priority charging queues, and automated
billing.

# What can PVMARS's energy storage system do?

Solar panels generate electricity quietly and complete their power generation tasks. Power your
home, hotel, factory, etc need for a day.

But neither solar panels nor wind turbines can store electricity on their own. Once there is no
sunlight and no wind, you will lose their power generation function.

At this time, the energy storage system (ESS) can help you solve this problem.

PVMARS’s energy storage system includes gel batteries, lithium iron phosphate batteries, flow
batteries, etc. Use batteries to store electricity generated by solar panels and wind turbines.

You will have electricity at your fingertips, making it available wherever power is needed.

Don’t wait anymore, start your electricity plan today!

# What can PVMARS's energy storage system do?

Solar panels generate electricity quietly and complete their power generation tasks. Power your
home, hotel, factory, etc need for a day.

But neither solar panels nor wind turbines can store electricity on their own. Once there is no
sunlight and no wind, you will lose their power generation function.

At this time, the energy storage system (ESS) can help you solve this problem.

PVMARS’s energy storage system includes gel batteries, lithium iron phosphate batteries, flow
batteries, etc. Use batteries to store electricity generated by solar panels and wind turbines.

You will have electricity at your fingertips, making it available wherever power is needed.

Don’t wait anymore, start your electricity plan today!

ABOUT US


Wuxi PRD New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. (a subsidiary of Wuxi Quanyu Electronic Technology) is a
leading innovator and manufacturer of Smart lithium battery systems. Established in 2014, we're
committed to delivering innovative and customized energy solutions for industrial and commercial
applications. We specialize in R&D, production, and sales of lithium batteries and chargers, we
power diverse equipment—including floor scrubbers, forklifts, aerial platforms, heavy-duty trucks,
golf carts, and RVs—for clients worldwide, such as Kärcher, Tennant and Hako.

With 10+ years of expertise, our 7,500+㎡ automated facility houses 4 lithium battery lines, 2
charger lines, producing 100,000+ battery packs and 200,000+ chargers annually. Certified to ISO
9001, CE, UN38.3, CB, ETL, ROHS, REACH, we ensure zero-defect quality from raw materials to final
products. Our dedicated R&D team holds 80+ patents and develops proprietary technologies, including
self-designed BMS systems certified to IEC 60730. Supported by a European subsidiary in Poland and
strategic partnerships with top suppliers (EVE, CATL), we guarantee fast delivery, premium
materials, and cost-efficient solutions. At PRD, we combine innovation, quality, and global reach to
drive the future of energy storage. Our mission is to provide sustainable, safe, and
high-performance lithium battery systems that redefine efficiency across industries.

ABOUT US


Wuxi PRD New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. (a subsidiary of Wuxi Quanyu Electronic Technology) is a
leading innovator and manufacturer of Smart lithium battery systems. Established in 2014, we're
committed to delivering innovative and customized energy solutions for industrial and commercial
applications. We specialize in R&D, production, and sales of lithium batteries and chargers, we
power diverse equipment—including floor scrubbers, forklifts, aerial platforms, heavy-duty trucks,
golf carts, and RVs—for clients worldwide, such as Kärcher, Tennant and Hako.

With 10+ years of expertise, our 7,500+㎡ automated facility houses 4 lithium battery lines, 2
charger lines, producing 100,000+ battery packs and 200,000+ chargers annually. Certified to ISO
9001, CE, UN38.3, CB, ETL, ROHS, REACH, we ensure zero-defect quality from raw materials to final
products. Our dedicated R&D team holds 80+ patents and develops proprietary technologies, including
self-designed BMS systems certified to IEC 60730. Supported by a European subsidiary in Poland and
strategic partnerships with top suppliers (EVE, CATL), we guarantee fast delivery, premium
materials, and cost-efficient solutions. At PRD, we combine innovation, quality, and global reach to
drive the future of energy storage. Our mission is to provide sustainable, safe, and
high-performance lithium battery systems that redefine efficiency across industries.

From early development to construction, operations, and digital optimisation, we're with you every

project portfolio

Our passionate and experienced people transform the way energy is generated, stored, shared and used
across the world.

### Development

Building meaningful relationships with local stakeholders to develop successful projects.

[ Learn more ][176]

### Construction

Using cutting-edge technology and people expertise to deliver high quality construction projects.

[ Learn more ][177]

Our expert team fully optimise and maintain your assets, maximising value and protecting revenue.

[ Learn more ][178]

Using AI and machine learning to find new ways to drive positive outcomes.

## About Us

Founded in 1961, the **LNJ Bhilwara Group** is a leading Indian industrial conglomerate with 17
companies, 21 manufacturing units, and 9 marketing offices, operating across textiles, power
generation, graphite electrodes, and IT services in over 80 countries.

**Replus Engitech Private Limited, **develops advanced lithium-ion Battery Energy Storage Systems
(BESS) to support India’s clean energy transition. It offers battery solutions for EVs
(2W/3W/e-rickshaws/e-buses/fleets), residential, telecom, and stationary storage, along with
customized products like AGV, UPS, and inverter batteries.

With in-house expertise in BMS/EMS, battery monitoring, and cell integration, REPLUS enables
gigafactory-scale assembly and provides end-to-end ESS solutions—from design and manufacturing to
commissioning and lifecycle support—driven by a team with deep renewable energy expertise.

## Our Offerings

Powering electric mobility with high-performance battery packs for 2W, 3W, buses, and commercial
vehicles.
Designed for efficiency, safety, and seamless integration across platforms.

### [Mobility][19]

[ Read more ][20]
Reliable lithium-ion energy storage systems for residential, telecom, and industrial backup. 
Engineered for uninterrupted power, grid support, and energy optimization. 

### [Stationary][21]

[ Read more ][22]
Tailor-made battery solutions for AGVs, robotics, and specialized applications. 
Flexible designs that meet unique operational needs with precision and durability.

## About Us

Founded in 1961, the **LNJ Bhilwara Group** is a leading Indian industrial conglomerate with 17
companies, 21 manufacturing units, and 9 marketing offices, operating across textiles, power
generation, graphite electrodes, and IT services in over 80 countries.

**Replus Engitech Private Limited, **develops advanced lithium-ion Battery Energy Storage Systems
(BESS) to support India’s clean energy transition. It offers battery solutions for EVs
(2W/3W/e-rickshaws/e-buses/fleets), residential, telecom, and stationary storage, along with
customized products like AGV, UPS, and inverter batteries.

With in-house expertise in BMS/EMS, battery monitoring, and cell integration, REPLUS enables
gigafactory-scale assembly and provides end-to-end ESS solutions—from design and manufacturing to
commissioning and lifecycle support—driven by a team with deep renewable energy expertise.

## Our Offerings

Powering electric mobility with high-performance battery packs for 2W, 3W, buses, and commercial
vehicles.
Designed for efficiency, safety, and seamless integration across platforms.

## Welcome to Reynold India Pvt. Ltd.

**Established in 1995**, Reynold India is an Indian company specializing in the design and
manufacturing of [industrial water chillers and cooling solutions][127]. It stands as one of the
largest producers of high performance chillers in the country, with a broad range of products that
serve industries like pharmaceuticals, plastics, food processing, and power generation. Our
offerings include **air cooled and water cooled chillers**, as well as **[customized
chillers][128]** for specific applications such as **[medical equipment][129]** and hazardous
environments.

Our rigorous dedication to innovation, quality, and energy efficiency has made Reynold chillers a
respected name in both domestic and international markets, exporting to over **63+** countries
across the world. We also offer machines that comply with international certifications such as
**ASME, CE, UL** etc to ensure reliability across diverse industrial needs.

Our founder and **CEO, Susanta Rakshit**, along with the management team, has grown Reynold India
from modest beginnings into a global competitor operating out of three manufacturing facilities,
based in India. With our focus being on continually adapting to technological advancements and
client demands, today, we continue to support a range of sectors by providing cooling solutions that
are both effective and environmentally sustainable.

## Welcome to Reynold India Pvt. Ltd.

**Established in 1995**, Reynold India is an Indian company specializing in the design and
manufacturing of [industrial water chillers and cooling solutions][127]. It stands as one of the
largest producers of high performance chillers in the country, with a broad range of products that
serve industries like pharmaceuticals, plastics, food processing, and power generation. Our
offerings include **air cooled and water cooled chillers**, as well as **[customized
chillers][128]** for specific applications such as **[medical equipment][129]** and hazardous
environments.

Our rigorous dedication to innovation, quality, and energy efficiency has made Reynold chillers a
respected name in both domestic and international markets, exporting to over **63+** countries
across the world. We also offer machines that comply with international certifications such as
**ASME, CE, UL** etc to ensure reliability across diverse industrial needs.

Our founder and **CEO, Susanta Rakshit**, along with the management team, has grown Reynold India
from modest beginnings into a global competitor operating out of three manufacturing facilities,
based in India. With our focus being on continually adapting to technological advancements and
client demands, today, we continue to support a range of sectors by providing cooling solutions that
are both effective and environmentally sustainable.

## FAQs

Which inverters does your battery energy storage system support?

Our BESS is compatible with most mainstream inverters, such as Deye, Growatt, Voltronic, Victron,
Luxpower, Sofar, Goodwe, Solis, SMA, INVT etc.

What is the cycle life of your energy storage battery?

Our energy storage battery can exceed 6000 cycles in its lifespan. We use high-quality cells from
Ganfeng, EVE, and Cornex. As one of the experienced battery energy storage system manufacturers, we
are committed to providing high-quality, reliable, and safe energy storage solutions.

Do you have overseas warehouses? Can you ship from those locations?

We have two overseas warehouses, located in Germany and Poland. Some energy storage batteries
will be shipped from these warehouses You could confirm the inventory status with our sales team
before placing an order.

Does your energy storage battery feature active balancing?

Yes. The smart BMS3.0 supports up to 10A of active balancing current, making the battery truly
maintenance-free and significantly extending its service life.

Do you have any international certifications?

We are the leading BESS manufacturer, holding many certifications, like CE, ROHS, IEC62133,
IEC62619, etc.

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What information do you need to recommend a suitable BESS?

Please provide the project country, application, required power and capacity, load profile,
available solar capacity, grid conditions and expected operating mode. If some information is
unavailable, our engineering team can help you complete the initial assessment.

Can MegSolid provide system sizing and ROI analysis?

Yes. Based on your electricity consumption, local tariff structure and operating strategy, our
engineering team can provide a preliminary capacity recommendation, system configuration and ROI
assessment.

Which certifications are available for MegSolid energy storage systems?

Certification availability depends on the product model and destination market. We can provide
model-specific certificates and third-party test reports for review before quotation and order
confirmation.

How is the safety of a hybrid solid-state BESS verified?

Hybrid solid-state battery technology is designed to improve thermal stability by reducing the
amount of liquid electrolyte. System safety also depends on the BMS, thermal management, electrical
protection and fire suppression design. Model-specific safety reports are available upon request.

What system capacities are available?

Our portfolio includes outdoor C&I energy storage cabinets and containerized BESS solutions,
covering projects from approximately 215kWh to 5MWh. Multiple systems can be connected in parallel
for larger projects.

Can MegSolid provide a complete turnkey energy storage solution?

Yes. Depending on the project, we can integrate battery cabinets, PCS, EMS, thermal management, fire
protection and remote monitoring into one coordinated solution. Grid connection and site-specific
requirements are confirmed during system design.

Do you support customized or OEM/ODM projects?

Yes. We can evaluate customized capacity, voltage, communication protocols, cabinet design, EMS
strategy, branding and documentation requirements. Feasibility depends on project volume and
certification requirements.

What warranty and after-sales support do you provide?

Warranty terms vary by product and project configuration. Before order confirmation, we provide
written warranty coverage, operating conditions and service responsibilities. Remote commissioning,
technical training and troubleshooting support are also available.

What is the typical project lead time?

Lead time depends on system capacity, customization, certification and order quantity. We provide a
preliminary technical proposal within 24 hours and confirm the production and delivery schedule
after the final configuration is approved.

Why choose MegSolid as a hybrid solid-state battery partner?

MegSolid combines battery technology expertise, energy storage system integration, and global
project experience to provide safe, scalable, and high-performance hybrid solid-state battery
solutions.

What is a hybrid solid-state battery, and how is it different from a conventional lithium-ion
battery?

A hybrid solid-state battery combines solid-electrolyte technology with a controlled amount of
liquid electrolyte. Compared with conventional lithium-ion batteries that rely mainly on liquid
electrolytes, this design is intended to improve thermal stability, reduce electrolyte leakage and
lower thermal-runaway risk while maintaining practical ionic conductivity and manufacturing
scalability.

## Six Core Manufacturing Technologies for MegSolid Hybrid Solid-State Batteries

Our hybrid solid-state cell engineering focuses on three critical areas: electrolyte integration,
interface protection and lithium management. These process capabilities are designed to improve cell
consistency, thermal stability and long-term cycling performance.
* **In Situ Solidification:** Designed to form a more continuous electrolyte interface inside the
  cell and improve contact between active materials.
* **Solid Electrolyte Blending:** Supports more uniform material distribution and consistent
  electrochemical performance across cells.
* **Solid-Electrolyte-Coated Cathode:** A functional coating designed to improve cathode–electrolyte
  interface stability and lithium-ion transport.
* **Solid-Electrolyte-Coated Separator:** Adds a functional interface layer to support controlled
  ion transport and thermal stability.
* **Ultrathin Lithium Metal Fabrication:** Enables precise thickness control and more efficient
  utilization of lithium materials.
* **High-Precision Anode Prelithiation:** Helps compensate for initial lithium loss and supports
  more stable long-term cycling performance.

What information do you need to recommend a suitable BESS?

Please provide the project country, application, required power and capacity, load profile,

Which certifications are available for MegSolid energy storage systems?

Certification availability depends on the product model and destination market. We can provide
model-specific certificates and third-party test reports for review before quotation and order
confirmation.

Hybrid solid-state battery technology is designed to improve thermal stability by reducing the
amount of liquid electrolyte. System safety also depends on the BMS, thermal management, electrical
protection and fire suppression design. Model-specific safety reports are available upon request.

Our portfolio includes outdoor C&I energy storage cabinets and containerized BESS solutions,
covering projects from approximately 215kWh to 5MWh. Multiple systems can be connected in parallel

protection and remote monitoring into one coordinated solution. Grid connection and site-specific

# **Policy Advocacy******

Our team is advocating for critical laws and forward-thinking policies that are shaping the future
of energy storage and securing a more resilient, reliable, and sustainable energy system for
communities nationwide.

#### **ILLINOIS**

SEIA led a broad coalition to pass a** 3,000 MW procurement for Battery Energy Storage Systems**
(BESS). This legislation will break open new markets for grid-scale, distributed, and
behind-the-meter energy storage while saving Illinois customers an estimated $13 billion over 20
years.

#### **NATIONAL**

SEIA’s congressional team kicked into overdrive in 2025 and **saved the investment tax credits for
BESS,** ensuring policy certainty and financial security for most projects.

#### **COLORADO**

SEIA secured a major victory with the state’s Public Utility Commission with **the adoption of a
Virtual Power Plant program and flexible interconnection tariff requirements**, which will create
major market opportunities for energy storage.

# **Policy Priorities**

With boots on the ground in roughly 15 states and a deep bench of experts advocating for our
industry in Congress and at the federal agencies, SEIA is fighting to open markets for energy
storage across the country.

#### Defend and implement federal BESS policies
* SEIA advocates for reasonable and attainable Foreign Entities of Concern (FEOC) guidance and
  Treasury Department rules.
* SEIA is actively fighting to protect federal programs in the Executive Branch that promote storage
  development.
* Finally, SEIA is working to preserve the supply and affordability of BESS products as supply
  chains onshore and decouple themselves from FEOC countries.

#### Launch and implement state-level programs to financially support energy storage

In states across the country, SEIA is leading legislative and regulatory efforts to ensure that
utilities open paid programs for grid-scale and distributed BESS, both front-of and
behind-the-meter.

#### Secure fair access to markets

SEIA fights for fair valuation of energy storage in forward capacity markets (Effective Load
Carrying Capacity – “ELCC”) for grid-scale and distributed BESS.

#### Reduce interconnection costs
* SEIA advocates for flexible interconnection tariffs so BESS can get on the grid faster and more
  affordably.
* SEIA is continuing our steadfast support for surplus interconnection service at regional
  transmission organizations (RTOs) and independent system operators (ISOs).

#### Secure favorable retail rates for distribution BESS

SEIA pushes the implementation of affordable distribution retail rates so projects can
cost-effectively pull energy from the grid to charge.

#### Lower barriers to siting
* SEIA is working to keep cities and counties “open for business” for BESS, leading to lower bills
  and higher reliability.
* SEIA policy experts are diligently crafting and promoting bills that streamline BESS siting while
  opposing and defeating bills with onerous siting requirements.

# **Policy Advocacy******

Our team is advocating for critical laws and forward-thinking policies that are shaping the future
of energy storage and securing a more resilient, reliable, and sustainable energy system for
communities nationwide.

#### **ILLINOIS**

SEIA led a broad coalition to pass a** 3,000 MW procurement for Battery Energy Storage Systems**
(BESS). This legislation will break open new markets for grid-scale, distributed, and
behind-the-meter energy storage while saving Illinois customers an estimated $13 billion over 20
years.

#### **NATIONAL**

SEIA’s congressional team kicked into overdrive in 2025 and **saved the investment tax credits for
BESS,** ensuring policy certainty and financial security for most projects.

#### **COLORADO**

SEIA secured a major victory with the state’s Public Utility Commission with **the adoption of a
Virtual Power Plant program and flexible interconnection tariff requirements**, which will create
major market opportunities for energy storage.

# **Policy Priorities**

With boots on the ground in roughly 15 states and a deep bench of experts advocating for our
industry in Congress and at the federal agencies, SEIA is fighting to open markets for energy
storage across the country.

#### Defend and implement federal BESS policies
* SEIA advocates for reasonable and attainable Foreign Entities of Concern (FEOC) guidance and
  Treasury Department rules.
* SEIA is actively fighting to protect federal programs in the Executive Branch that promote storage
  development.
* Finally, SEIA is working to preserve the supply and affordability of BESS products as supply
  chains onshore and decouple themselves from FEOC countries.

#### Launch and implement state-level programs to financially support energy storage

In states across the country, SEIA is leading legislative and regulatory efforts to ensure that
utilities open paid programs for grid-scale and distributed BESS, both front-of and
behind-the-meter.

#### Secure fair access to markets

SEIA fights for fair valuation of energy storage in forward capacity markets (Effective Load
Carrying Capacity – “ELCC”) for grid-scale and distributed BESS.

#### Reduce interconnection costs
* SEIA advocates for flexible interconnection tariffs so BESS can get on the grid faster and more
  affordably.
* SEIA is continuing our steadfast support for surplus interconnection service at regional
  transmission organizations (RTOs) and independent system operators (ISOs).

#### Secure favorable retail rates for distribution BESS

SEIA pushes the implementation of affordable distribution retail rates so projects can
cost-effectively pull energy from the grid to charge.

#### Lower barriers to siting
* SEIA is working to keep cities and counties “open for business” for BESS, leading to lower bills
  and higher reliability.
* SEIA policy experts are diligently crafting and promoting bills that streamline BESS siting while
  opposing and defeating bills with onerous siting requirements.
* In conjunction with our state affairs and codes & standards team, SEIA experts are guiding state
  officials in setting evidence-based standards for siting and fire protection.
* In a time of regulatory uncertainty, we are continuing to push Federal agencies to issue permits
  in accordance with laws and reasonable regulations.

# **Codes and Standards**

The deployment of energy storage is heavily impacted by building, electrical, and fire codes. In
forums across the country, SEIA has experts advocating for reasonable, consistent, and
evidence-based codes and standards that maintain the highest levels of safety without inflating the
costs to build.

[Learn More][15]

#### Regional Consistency

SEIA is advocating to ensure BESS systems have consistent installations and maintenance across all
states and regions. Our policy experts are prioritizing coordination of Code Provisions, ensuring
hazard prevention and mitigation.

#### Clear Guidance

SEIA is focusing on improving permitting and siting guidance for BESS to enable safe, scalable,
long-term deployment of residential, small-scale commercial, and large-scale BESS systems. SEIA
supports simplifying the International Residential Code.

#### Collaborative Development

SEIA is working to close regulatory gaps across the battery lifecycle. Partnering with industry
members, we prioritize knowledge-sharing and development of proper code chapters and sections on
battery collection, sorting, and recycling.

#### Policymaker Engagement

SEIA policy experts are creating model ordinances in order to engage and educate decision-makers at
federal agencies and other regulatory bodies.

## Innovation to Transform the Future of Energy Storage

batteries, allowing our customers to select the right chemistry or combination of chemistries to
design a solution that best fits their energy needs.

Vanadium Redox Flow Batteries


**Vanadium Redox Flow Batteries**

Stryten Energy’s [Vanadium Redox Flow Battery][79] (VRFB) is uniquely suited for applications that
require medium– to long–duration energy storage from 4 to 12 hours. Examples include microgrids,
utility-scale storage, data centers and military bases. Stryten Energy’s VRFB offers
industry-leading power density with a versatile, modular platform for stable capacity and novel,
high-temperature electrolyte formulations. Design breakthroughs and advanced material development
deliver safe, cost-effective, and reliable large-scale energy storage systems.

We visit Paul Stretton's lodge house to see his Victron Energy system that runs everything from a

[Why 15 People Share One Off-Grid Estate in the Netherlands]

### Why 15 People Share One Off-Grid Estate in the Netherlands

A family of 15 across three generations runs a fully self-sufficient estate in South Netherlands,
growing around 70% of their own food, pumping water from 50 metres underground, and generating all
their own power from roughly 300 solar panels.

[How a cow schedule kept shutting down this printers]

### How a cow schedule kept shutting down this printers

At the end of a weak rural grid in County Offaly, a print and design studio lost power every time a
neighbouring farmer milked his cows.

[Telly Award for 50 Years of Victron Energy film]

A rare interview with Victron's founder Reinout Vader and his son, CTO Matthijs, has led to an
exceptional honour. Our 50 Years of Victron Energy film has won bronze at the annual Telly Awards,
competing against some of the biggest names in documentary filmmaking.

[Inside the Dutch Barn that must NEVER Lose Power]

### Inside the Dutch Barn that must NEVER Lose Power

This converted cow barn is quietly running a global payment app used by over a million people around
the clock.

# Shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy


Our everyday lives depend on a steady supply of electricity and goods shipped to us from across the
world.

Yet, marine and energy generate over a third of global greenhouse gases. That’s why we’re shaping
the decarbonisation of marine and energy.

[About us][8]

2050

net-zero target year
for shipping and energy

180

countries with our
energy installations

110,000

vessels sailing worldwide,
one-third using our solutions

3,500

Wärtsilä service professionals
in the field

## Enabling you to cut emissions at sea and on land

We help our customers take a decarbonisation journey that is environmentally sustainable and
financially viable.

[Senayan power plant in Indonesia]
[lightning-icon]
Energy

We help the energy sector accelerate the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future with our
market-leading technologies and power system expertise. Energy providers globally rely on our
flexible engine power plants, energy storage systems, intelligent optimisation technologies, and
lifecycle services. With reliable, affordable, and sustainable power as your goal, our solutions
support you in ramping up and balancing intermittent renewables.

[Wärtsilä in energy][9]

# Support the energy transition and reduce carbon emissions

We focus on developing and producing energy storage solutions that utilize advanced technologies
such as lithium-ion batteries to support the energy transition and reduce carbon emissions. Our goal
is to provide a reliable means of energy storage for the large-scale application of renewable
energy, promote the establishment of a more sustainable and low-carbon energy system, and contribute
to the achievement of global climate goals.

## Energy Storage Manufacturer

Voltsmiles is a manufacturer specialising in researching, developing, and producing lithium battery
storage systems. With the company headquarters located in Shenzhen, and several manufacturing
facilities in Huizhou, Jiangxi, Dongguan and market centres in Amsterdam and Dusseldorf. We aim to
provide the most satisfactory services with sales and support networks over all continents.

## Fast Production & Delivery

7 automated lines, 500,000Ah monthly capacity, supporting fast lead times.

## Global Certifications

## Our Quality Control Process

### Raw Material Control

Strict incoming inspection of CATL cells and components, only qualified materials enter production.

### Process Control

Automated assembly and real-time monitoring at every production stage to avoid defects.

### Multi-stage Performance QC

Charge/discharge, overcharge/over-discharge and short-circuit testing for safety.

### Pre-shipment Inspection & Testing

Full function testing and aging test before shipment, ensuring zero defective products.

Sam
Yuchuan Engineering Team Our technical team has over 10 years of experience in custom lithium
battery design and manufacturing, dedicated to solving performance, safety and compatibility
challenges for global clients.
* **Choose the Right Cell Chemistry for Your Application**
  
  Select cells that match your power, cycle life and environmental requirements. CATL LiFePO4 cells
  are ideal for long-cycle energy storage, while high-power options suit electric vehicle
  applications.
* **Optimize BMS Configuration for Operating Conditions**
  
  Program the BMS to fit your actual environment. Adjust over/under-voltage protection, temperature
  cut-offs, current limits and communication protocols to prevent false triggers and ensure stable
  performance.
* **Design the Enclosure for Durability and Safety**
  
  Ensure the battery housing has proper IP sealing and structural reinforcement, especially for
  outdoor and tricycle use. Good shock absorption and thermal management prevent internal damage and
  safety risks during vibration or high temperatures.
* **Specify Realistic Dimensional and Fit Tolerances**
  
  Balance installation fit and manufacturing feasibility. Over-tight tolerances raise production
  costs and lead times, while excessive clearances risk movement, loose connections and potential
  short-circuit issues.

FAQs

## Frequently Asked Questions

Are you a factory or trading company?

We are a professional lithium battery manufacturer based in Linyi, China, with 15,000㎡ of
production facilities, 7 automated production lines, and an in-house R&D team. We offer full OEM/ODM
services, from design and prototyping to mass production and global shipping.

What certifications do your products have?

Our lithium batteries comply with major international standards, including ISO9001 (quality
management), CE/ROHS (EU safety), and UN38.3 (transport safety). All certifications are available
for your customs clearance and market access.

Do you accept customization?

Yes, we support full customization to meet your exact needs, including:

• Electrical specs: Voltage, capacity, BMS parameters, discharge rate

• Mechanical design: Size, shape, enclosure material

• Appearance: Brand logo, color, packaging

We can handle both small prototype orders and large bulk production.

What is the delivery time?

We focus on 6 core series:

• Electric two/three-wheeler batteries
• Outdoor portable power stations
• Home/off-grid solar energy storage
• Telecom base station backup batteries
• Industrial traction batteries
• Large customized battery packs

What is the lead time?

Standard products usually ship in 7-15 days. Custom orders depend on complexity, but we’ll provide a
clear timeline after confirming your requirements. We prioritize fast production without
compromising quality.

How to get a quote?

You can submit an inquiry on our website, or contact us directly via email/WhatsApp with your
battery specifications (voltage, capacity, application, quantity). Our team will reply with a
detailed quote within 24 hours.

Sam
Yuchuan Engineering Team Our technical team has over 10 years of experience in custom lithium
battery design and manufacturing, dedicated to solving performance, safety and compatibility
challenges for global clients.
* **Choose the Right Cell Chemistry for Your Application**
  
  Select cells that match your power, cycle life and environmental requirements. CATL LiFePO4 cells
  are ideal for long-cycle energy storage, while high-power options suit electric vehicle
  applications.
* **Optimize BMS Configuration for Operating Conditions**
  
  Program the BMS to fit your actual environment. Adjust over/under-voltage protection, temperature
  cut-offs, current limits and communication protocols to prevent false triggers and ensure stable
  performance.
* **Design the Enclosure for Durability and Safety**
  
  Ensure the battery housing has proper IP sealing and structural reinforcement, especially for
  outdoor and tricycle use. Good shock absorption and thermal management prevent internal damage and
  safety risks during vibration or high temperatures.
* **Specify Realistic Dimensional and Fit Tolerances**
  
  Balance installation fit and manufacturing feasibility. Over-tight tolerances raise production
  costs and lead times, while excessive clearances risk movement, loose connections and potential
  short-circuit issues.
